skills.body:
# Expense Categorizer

Takes a list of transactions and puts each one in a plain-English category the owner can understand and the accountant can use. It is consistent (same vendor → same category), honest about items it is unsure of, and keeps a running "rules" list so next month is faster.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- You have a bank or card export (CSV or pasted) with uncategorized items.
- Your bookkeeping app's auto-categories look wrong.
- You want a simple category list (chart of accounts) for a new business.

Do not use when:
- You want the full weekly routine → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine`.
- You want to know if you made a profit → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check`.
- You need help with tax filing, depreciation choices or complex deductions → talk to your CPA; see also accountant skills.

## What to ask for first

1. The transactions: date, description/vendor, amount (CSV columns or paste).
2. Business type (e.g., bakery, hair salon, design studio, plumbing) — it changes what is normal.
3. Your current category list, if any.
4. Known personal items, vehicles used for business, home office, and whether you pay contractors.

## Category list (simple, Schedule C–friendly)

Use the owner's list if they have one. Otherwise start with:
- Cost of goods / materials (inventory, ingredients, parts you resell)
- Advertising & marketing
- Car & truck (keep a mileage log; choose actual vs. standard mileage with your CPA)
- Contract labor (payments to non-employees → may need 1099-NEC)
- Wages & payroll taxes (from payroll provider)
- Rent – business space; Equipment rental
- Repairs & maintenance
- Supplies (small items used up in the business)
- Insurance (business, not health — ask CPA about health)
- Legal & professional fees (accountant, lawyer)
- Office expenses & software subscriptions
- Utilities & phone/internet (business share)
- Travel; Meals (business meals are usually only partly deductible [VERIFY])
- Bank & payment processing fees
- Taxes & licenses (business licenses; not income tax)
- Equipment purchases (larger items — CPA decides how to deduct)
- Owner draw / personal (not an expense)
- Transfer between own accounts (not an expense)
- Loan payment (principal is not an expense; interest is)
- Sales tax paid to the state (not an expense if you collected it from customers)
- Unclear — ask

## Steps

1. **Clean the list.** Remove duplicates and pending items; mark refunds as negative.
2. **Spot transfers and loans first** (transfers to savings, credit-card payments, loan payments) so they are not counted as spending.
3. **Categorize by vendor.** Create a rule per vendor ("Home Depot → Supplies unless note says inventory"). Apply the same rule every time.
4. **Mixed-use items** (phone, car, home internet, Amazon orders): split by business percentage only if the owner gives it; otherwise mark "Unclear — ask".
5. **Flag** anything personal-looking (groceries, streaming, clothing), large purchases that may be equipment, cash withdrawals, and payments to people (possible contractors).
6. **Contractor check.** Total payments per contractor for the year so far; note who may need a 1099-NEC. The reporting threshold has been $600 and is scheduled to change for payments made from 2026 [VERIFY current threshold]. Card/PayPal payments are often reported by the processor instead [VERIFY].
7. **Summarize** totals per category and a list of questions.

## Output format

```
| Date | Vendor/description | Amount | Category | Confidence (high/med/low) | Note / question |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Totals by category: ...
Vendor rules to save: Vendor → Category
Flags: personal-looking / possible equipment / mixed-use / cash
Contractor payments YTD: name — $ — W-9 on file? 
Questions for the owner/CPA: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Transfers, credit-card payments and loan principal are not counted as expenses.
- [ ] Same vendor always gets the same category (or the reason is noted).
- [ ] Low-confidence items are flagged, not forced into a category.
- [ ] Personal items are marked as owner draw, not hidden in business categories.
- [ ] No deduction is promised; "deductible" questions go to the CPA.

## Limits

- Not tax advice. Whether something is deductible, and how much, depends on facts your CPA or enrolled agent must decide.
- Never invents amounts, business-use percentages or tax thresholds; marks them [VERIFY].
- Category names are suggestions; keep whatever your accountant already uses.

# 지출 분류 도우미

거래 내역을 사장님이 이해하고 세무사가 바로 쓸 수 있는 쉬운 항목으로 나눕니다. 같은 거래처는 늘 같은 항목으로 분류하고, 확실하지 않은 것은 솔직하게 표시하며, "분류 규칙" 목록을 남겨 다음 달을 빠르게 합니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 통장·카드 내역(엑셀 또는 붙여넣기)에 분류가 안 된 거래가 많을 때

skills.body:
# Expense Categorizer (ख़र्चों का वर्गीकरण)

Entries की list को ऐसी आसान categories में डालता है जो मालिक समझे और CA सीधे इस्तेमाल करे। एक ही vendor हमेशा एक ही category में, अनिश्चित entries पर ईमानदार flag, और "rules" की list ताकि अगला महीना जल्दी हो।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- Bank/UPI statement (Excel/PDF या paste) में बिना category की entries हों।
- Tally/Vyapar/Zoho में ग़लत ledger में entries हों।
- नए बिज़नेस के लिए आसान ledger list चाहिए।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- पूरा weekly routine → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-hi`
- मुनाफ़ा देखना → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-hi`
- Depreciation, tax deduction या return भरना → CA से बात करें।

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. Entries: तारीख़, vendor/विवरण, राशि।
2. बिज़नेस का प्रकार (kirana, bakery, salon, boutique, CA/design studio, contractor)।
3. GST: regular, composition या registered नहीं (composition में input tax credit नहीं मिलता)।
4. पता हो तो निजी ख़र्च, बिज़नेस में इस्तेमाल होने वाली गाड़ी/फ़ोन, घर से काम।

## आसान categories (शुरुआत के लिए)

मालिक/CA की list हो तो वही। नहीं तो:
- Purchase / raw material / बेचने का माल
- किराया (दुकान/godown)
- Salary और wages; स्टाफ़ welfare (चाय-नाश्ता)
- Contractor / labour charges (TDS लग सकता है — Section 194C `[जाँचें]`)
- Professional fees (CA, वकील, designer — TDS Section 194J `[जाँचें]`)
- बिजली, पानी, phone/internet
- Transport, freight, courier, petrol (बिज़नेस वाला हिस्सा)
- Advertising (flex, pamphlet, Google/Instagram ads, Justdial package)
- Repairs और maintenance
- Packing material, stationery, consumables
- Bank charges, UPI/POS/payment gateway charges, platform commission
- Software/subscription (Tally, Vyapar, website)
- Insurance (दुकान/stock), licence fees, trade licence, shop act
- बड़ी ख़रीद — machine, furniture, computer (asset; CA depreciation तय करेंगे)
- Loan EMI: interest = ख़र्च, principal = ख़र्च नहीं
- GST payment (सरकार को) = ख़र्च नहीं; अलग ledger
- Drawings / निजी (ख़र्च नहीं); अपने accounts के बीच transfer (ख़र्च नहीं)
- साफ़ नहीं — पूछना है

## Steps

1. **साफ़ करें:** duplicate और failed UPI entries हटाएँ, refund को minus लिखें।
2. **पहले transfers और loans पहचानें** ताकि ख़र्च में न गिनें।
3. **Vendor rule बनाएँ:** "XYZ Traders → Purchase"। हर बार वही rule।
4. **GST invoice कॉलम:** supplier का GSTIN वाला tax invoice है? (regular dealer के लिए ITC तभी, जब supplier ने GSTR-1 में दिखाया हो और GSTR-2B में आए `[जाँचें]`)।

Entries की list को ऐसी आसान categories में डालता है जो मालिक समझे और CA सीधे इस्तेमाल करे। एक ही vendor हमेशा एक ही category में, अनिश्चित entries पर ईमानदार flag, और "rules" की list ताकि अगला महीना जल्दी हो।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- Bank/UPI statement (Excel/PDF या paste) में बिना category की entries हों।
- Tally/Vyapar/Zoho में ग़लत ledger में entries हों।
- नए बिज़नेस के लिए आसान ledger list चाहिए।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- पूरा weekly routine → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-hi`
- मुनाफ़ा देखना → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-hi`
- Depreciation, tax deduction या return भरना → CA से बात करें।

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. Entries: तारीख़, vendor/विवरण, राशि।
2. बिज़नेस का प्रकार (kirana, bakery, salon, boutique, CA/design studio, contractor)।
3. GST: regular, composition या registered नहीं (composition में input tax credit नहीं मिलता)।
4. पता हो तो निजी ख़र्च, बिज़नेस में इस्तेमाल होने वाली गाड़ी/फ़ोन, घर से काम।

## आसान categories (शुरुआत के लिए)

मालिक/CA की list हो तो वही। नहीं तो:
- Purchase / raw material / बेचने का माल
- किराया (दुकान/godown)
- Salary और wages; स्टाफ़ welfare (चाय-नाश्ता)
- Contractor / labour charges (TDS लग सकता है — Section 194C `[जाँचें]`)
- Professional fees (CA, वकील, designer — TDS Section 194J `[जाँचें]`)
- बिजली, पानी, phone/internet
- Transport, freight, courier, petrol (बिज़नेस वाला हिस्सा)
- Advertising (flex, pamphlet, Google/Instagram ads, Justdial package)
- Repairs और maintenance
- Packing material, stationery, consumables
- Bank charges, UPI/POS/payment gateway charges, platform commission
- Software/subscription (Tally, Vyapar, website)
- Insurance (दुकान/stock), licence fees, trade licence, shop act
- बड़ी ख़रीद — machine, furniture, computer (asset; CA depreciation तय करेंगे)
- Loan EMI: interest = ख़र्च, principal = ख़र्च नहीं
- GST payment (सरकार को) = ख़र्च नहीं; अलग ledger
- Drawings / निजी (ख़र्च नहीं); अपने accounts के बीच transfer (ख़र्च नहीं)
- साफ़ नहीं — पूछना है

2. **पहले transfers और loans पहचानें** ताकि ख़र्च में न गिनें।
3. **Vendor rule बनाएँ:** "XYZ Traders → Purchase"। हर बार वही rule।

```
Save करने वाले vendor rules: Vendor → Category
Flags: निजी शक / बड़ी ख़रीद / mixed / cash / TDS शायद
CA से सवाल: ...
```

- [ ] एक vendor = एक category (अलग हो तो कारण)।
- [ ] कम भरोसे वाली entries flag हुईं, ज़बरदस्ती category नहीं दी।

skills.name: smallbiz-monthly-profit-check
skills.description: Gives a small-business owner a plain-English monthly profit check — sales, cost of goods, gross margin, main expenses, net profit, and how this month compares with last month and the same month last year — plus 3 things to act on, from a simple P&L or bookkeeping export. Use for "did I make money this month", "monthly P&L in plain English", "why is profit down", "what are my margins", or "month review".
skills.body:
# Monthly Profit Check

A 20-minute monthly look at whether the business made money, where the money went, and what to change. Written for owners who are not accountants: no jargon without a one-line explanation, and every number traced to the books.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- The month's books are done (weekly routine completed) and you want the picture.
- Profit or cash feels off and you want to know why.
- Preparing a short update for a business partner or spouse.

Do not use when:
- Books are not up to date → first run `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine`.
- You need to know future cash, not past profit → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week`.
- You need formal financial statements for a bank or investor → accountant skill `fs-draft-from-trial-balance` or your CPA.
- You want to set prices → `smallbiz-pricing-calculator` (task prepare-quotes).

## What to ask for first

1. The month's Profit & Loss report (from QuickBooks/Xero/Wave) or category totals from your spreadsheet.
2. Last month and the same month last year, if available.
3. Anything unusual this month: closure days, big one-off purchase, price change, new staff, event.
4. Your goal, if any (e.g., "15% profit", "$4,000 owner pay").

## Steps

1. **Check the inputs.** Are all bank and card accounts reconciled? Are big one-offs (equipment, annual insurance) in the month? Note anything that distorts the picture.
2. **Calculate the basics** (show the math):
   - Sales (net of refunds; excluding sales tax collected).
   - Cost of goods/materials → **gross profit** = sales − cost of goods; **gross margin %** = gross profit ÷ sales.
   - Operating expenses by category (rent, wages, marketing, software, etc.).
   - **Net profit** = gross profit − operating expenses. Net margin % = net profit ÷ sales.
   - Owner pay: in a sole proprietorship/single-member LLC, owner draws are not an expense — show profit before owner draw and the draw separately.
3. **Compare** with last month and same month last year: show $ and % change for sales, gross margin and the 3 biggest expense lines.
4. **Explain the top 3 changes** in one sentence each, using only facts from the books or the owner's notes. If the reason is unknown, say "unknown — check".
5. **Simple health signals:** gross margin falling? any expense growing faster than sales? breakeven sales for the month (fixed costs ÷ gross margin %).
6. **Pick 3 actions** for next month (e.g., raise price on low-margin item, renegotiate supplier, cut unused subscription, push higher-margin service).
7. **Tax reminder:** estimate of profit so far this year is useful for quarterly estimated taxes — share with CPA; do not calculate tax owed here.

## Output format

```
Profit check — [Business] — [Month Year]

| | This month | Last month | Same month last year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sales | | | |
| Cost of goods | | | |
| Gross profit (margin %) | | | |
| Operating expenses | | | |
| Net profit before owner draw (margin %) | | | |
| Owner draw | | | |

Biggest changes: 1… 2… 3…
Breakeven sales this month: $[ ]  (fixed costs $[ ] ÷ gross margin [ ]%)
3 actions for next month: ...
Data issues / [VERIFY]: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Sales exclude sales tax collected and transfers.
- [ ] Owner draws and loan principal are not counted as expenses.
- [ ] Every % shows what it is a percentage of.
- [ ] Explanations do not guess — unknown reasons are marked.
- [ ] Actions are specific and doable by a small team in a month.

## Limits

- Management view only; not tax or accounting advice and not formal financial statements.
- Never invents numbers, industry benchmarks or tax amounts; mark any benchmark you use [VERIFY].
- Cash-basis and accrual books can show different profit; ask your CPA which you use.

skills.name: smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-ko
skills.description: 사장님을 위한 쉬운 월간 손익 점검입니다. 매출, 재료·매입비, 매출총이익률, 주요 비용, 순이익을 계산하고 지난달·작년 같은 달과 비교해 바뀐 이유와 다음 달 할 일 3가지를 정리합니다. 배달앱 수수료·카드 수수료 비중도 봅니다. "이번 달 남았나요", "월 손익 쉽게", "왜 이익이 줄었지", "마진 계산", "월 결산 요약" 같은 요청에 사용합니다.
skills.body:
# 월간 손익 점검

한 달에 20분, 이번 달 장사가 남았는지, 돈이 어디로 갔는지, 무엇을 바꿀지 봅니다. 회계 전문가가 아닌 사장님을 위해 쉬운 말로 쓰고, 모든 숫자를 장부에서 가져옵니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 한 달 장부 정리가 끝나고 전체 그림을 보고 싶을 때
- 이익이나 현금이 이상하게 느껴질 때
- 동업자·가족에게 짧게 보고할 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 장부가 밀려 있음 → 먼저 `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-ko`
- 앞으로의 현금 → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-ko`
- 은행·투자자용 정식 재무제표 → 세무사·회계사
- 가격 정하기 → `smallbiz-pricing-calculator-ko`

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 이번 달 손익 자료(경리 앱 리포트, 세무사 기장 자료, 엑셀 항목별 합계)
2. 지난달, 작년 같은 달 자료(있으면)
3. 이번 달 특이 사항: 휴무일, 큰 일회성 구매, 가격 변경, 직원 변화, 행사·명절
4. 목표(예: "순이익률 15%", "대표 몫 월 300만 원")
5. 사업자 유형(간이·일반·면세) — 매출에 부가세가 포함되었는지 판단에 필요합니다.

## 작성 절차

1. **자료 점검**: 모든 통장·카드가 맞춰졌는지, 큰 일회성 지출(장비, 연간 보험)이 이번 달에 몰렸는지 확인하고 왜곡 요인을 적습니다.
2. **기본 계산(식을 보여 줍니다)**
   - 매출: 환불 제외, 일반과세자는 부가세를 뺀 공급가액 기준
   - 재료·매입비 → **매출총이익** = 매출 − 재료·매입비, **매출총이익률** = 매출총이익 ÷ 매출
   - 운영비 항목별(임차료, 인건비, 광고비, 수수료 등)
   - **순이익** = 매출총이익 − 운영비, 순이익률 = 순이익 ÷ 매출
   - 개인사업자의 대표 인출은 비용이 아닙니다. 인출 전 이익과 인출액을 따로 보여 줍니다.
3. **수수료 비중**: 카드 수수료, 배달앱·플랫폼 수수료·광고비 합계가 매출의 몇 %인지 계산합니다.
4. **비교**: 지난달·작년 같은 달 대비 매출, 매출총이익률, 큰 비용 3개의 금액과 % 변화
5. **변화 이유 3가지**: 장부나 사장님 메모에 있는 사실로만 한 문장씩. 모르면 "원인 미상 — 확인"
6. **건강 신호**: 매출총이익률 하락, 매출보다 빨리 느는 비용, 이번 달 손익분기 매출(고정비 ÷ 매출총이익률)

# 월간 손익 점검

한 달에 20분, 이번 달 장사가 남았는지, 돈이 어디로 갔는지, 무엇을 바꿀지 봅니다. 회계 전문가가 아닌 사장님을 위해 쉬운 말로 쓰고, 모든 숫자를 장부에서 가져옵니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 한 달 장부 정리가 끝나고 전체 그림을 보고 싶을 때
- 이익이나 현금이 이상하게 느껴질 때
- 동업자·가족에게 짧게 보고할 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 장부가 밀려 있음 → 먼저 `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-ko`
- 앞으로의 현금 → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-ko`
- 은행·투자자용 정식 재무제표 → 세무사·회계사
- 가격 정하기 → `smallbiz-pricing-calculator-ko`

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 이번 달 손익 자료(경리 앱 리포트, 세무사 기장 자료, 엑셀 항목별 합계)
2. 지난달, 작년 같은 달 자료(있으면)
3. 이번 달 특이 사항: 휴무일, 큰 일회성 구매, 가격 변경, 직원 변화, 행사·명절
4. 목표(예: "순이익률 15%", "대표 몫 월 300만 원")
5. 사업자 유형(간이·일반·면세) — 매출에 부가세가 포함되었는지 판단에 필요합니다.

   - 매출: 환불 제외, 일반과세자는 부가세를 뺀 공급가액 기준

   - 운영비 항목별(임차료, 인건비, 광고비, 수수료 등)

# Monthly Profit Check (महीने की मुनाफ़ा जाँच)

महीने में 20 मिनट: बिज़नेस ने कमाया या नहीं, पैसा कहाँ गया, और क्या बदलना है। Accountant नहीं हैं ऐसे मालिकों के लिए — हर technical शब्द का एक line में मतलब, और हर आँकड़ा books से।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- महीने का हिसाब पूरा हो चुका हो और पूरी तस्वीर देखनी हो।
- मुनाफ़ा या cash गड़बड़ लगे और कारण जानना हो।
- Partner या परिवार को छोटा update देना हो।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- हिसाब पूरा नहीं → पहले `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-hi`
- आगे का cash → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-hi`
- Bank loan के लिए formal financial statements → CA
- Rate तय करना → `smallbiz-pricing-calculator-hi`

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. महीने की P&L report (Tally/Vyapar/Zoho) या Excel में category totals।
2. पिछला महीना और पिछले साल का वही महीना (अगर हो)।
3. इस महीने ख़ास: दुकान बंद रही, बड़ी एक-बार की ख़रीद, rate बदला, नया स्टाफ़, त्योहार/शादी season।
4. लक्ष्य (जैसे "15% मुनाफ़ा", "₹40,000 महीना अपने लिए")।
5. GST regular/composition — बिक्री में GST शामिल है या नहीं, यह तय करने के लिए।

## Steps

1. **Input जाँचें:** सारे bank/UPI accounts मिलाए गए? बड़ी एक-बार की ख़रीद (machine, साल भर का insurance) इसी महीने में? तस्वीर बिगाड़ने वाली बातें लिखें।
2. **बुनियादी गणना (हिसाब दिखाएँ):**
   - बिक्री: returns घटाकर, regular dealer हैं तो GST छोड़कर (taxable value)।
   - माल/raw material लागत → **gross profit** = बिक्री − माल लागत; **gross margin %** = gross profit ÷ बिक्री। Stock बहुत ऊपर-नीचे हुआ हो तो opening/closing stock का असर बताएँ।
   - चालू ख़र्च category के हिसाब से (किराया, salary, बिजली, advertising, commission)।
   - **Net profit** = gross profit − चालू ख़र्च; net margin % = net profit ÷ बिक्री।
   - Proprietor की drawings ख़र्च नहीं — drawings से पहले का मुनाफ़ा और drawings अलग दिखाएँ।
3. **Commission का हिस्सा:** Swiggy/Zomato/Amazon/Meesho commission, POS/payment gateway charges बिक्री का कितना %।
4. **तुलना:** पिछले महीने और पिछले साल के उसी महीने से बिक्री, gross margin और 3 बड़े ख़र्चों में ₹ और % बदलाव।
5. **3 सबसे बड़े बदलावों का कारण** — सिर्फ़ books या मालिक के notes से। पता नहीं तो "कारण पता नहीं — जाँचें"।
6. **सेहत के संकेत:** gross margin गिर रहा? कोई ख़र्च बिक्री से तेज़ बढ़ रहा? इस महीने का breakeven (fixed ख़र्च ÷ gross margin %)।
7. **अगले महीने के 3 काम:** कम margin वाले item का rate, supplier से rate बात, बेकार subscription बंद, ज़्यादा margin वाली service को आगे बढ़ाना।
8. **Tax note:** साल का अब तक का मुनाफ़ा advance tax/ITR की तैयारी में काम आएगा — CA को दें; यहाँ tax की गणना नहीं।

## Output format

```
Profit check — [बिज़नेस] — [महीना साल]

| | इस महीने | पिछला महीना | पिछले साल यही महीना |
|---|---|---|---|
| बिक्री (GST छोड़कर) | | | |
| माल/raw material लागत | | | |
| Gross profit (margin %) | | | |
| चालू ख़र्च | | | |
| Drawings से पहले net profit (margin %) | | | |
| Drawings | | | |
| Commission/charges % | | | |

बड़े बदलाव: 1… 2… 3…
इस महीने breakeven बिक्री: ₹[ ] (fixed ख़र्च ₹[ ] ÷ gross margin [ ]%)
अगले महीने के 3 काम: ...
Data की कमियाँ / [जाँचें]: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] बिक्री में GST collected और transfers शामिल नहीं।
- [ ] Drawings और loan principal ख़र्च में नहीं।
- [ ] हर % के साथ लिखा है कि किसका %।
- [ ] कारण अंदाज़े से नहीं; अनजान कारण चिह्नित।
- [ ] काम छोटी टीम एक महीने में कर सके ऐसे।

## Limits

- सिर्फ़ प्रबंधन के लिए; tax/accounting सलाह या formal statements नहीं।
- आँकड़े, industry benchmark या tax राशि नहीं गढ़ता; benchmark इस्तेमाल हो तो `[जाँचें]`।
- Cash basis और accrual basis में मुनाफ़ा अलग दिख सकता है; CA से पूछें।

## Steps

1. **Input जाँचें:** सारे bank/UPI accounts मिलाए गए? बड़ी एक-बार की ख़रीद (machine, साल भर का insurance) इसी महीने में? तस्वीर बिगाड़ने वाली बातें लिखें।
2. **बुनियादी गणना (हिसाब दिखाएँ):**
   - बिक्री: returns घटाकर, regular dealer हैं तो GST छोड़कर (taxable value)।
   - माल/raw material लागत → **gross profit** = बिक्री − माल लागत; **gross margin %** = gross profit ÷ बिक्री। Stock बहुत ऊपर-नीचे हुआ हो तो opening/closing stock का असर बताएँ।
   - चालू ख़र्च category के हिसाब से (किराया, salary, बिजली, advertising, commission)।
   - **Net profit** = gross profit − चालू ख़र्च; net margin % = net profit ÷ बिक्री।
   - Proprietor की drawings ख़र्च नहीं — drawings से पहले का मुनाफ़ा और drawings अलग दिखाएँ।
3. **Commission का हिस्सा:** Swiggy/Zomato/Amazon/Meesho commission, POS/payment gateway charges बिक्री का कितना %।
4. **तुलना:** पिछले महीने और पिछले साल के उसी महीने से बिक्री, gross margin और 3 बड़े ख़र्चों में ₹ और % बदलाव।
5. **3 सबसे बड़े बदलावों का कारण** — सिर्फ़ books या मालिक के notes से। पता नहीं तो "कारण पता नहीं — जाँचें"।
6. **सेहत के संकेत:** gross margin गिर रहा? कोई ख़र्च बिक्री से तेज़ बढ़ रहा? इस महीने का breakeven (fixed ख़र्च ÷ gross margin %)।
7. **अगले महीने के 3 काम:** कम margin वाले item का rate, supplier से rate बात, बेकार subscription बंद, ज़्यादा margin वाली service को आगे बढ़ाना।
8. **Tax note:** साल का अब तक का मुनाफ़ा advance tax/ITR की तैयारी में काम आएगा — CA को दें; यहाँ tax की गणना नहीं।

## Output format

```
Profit check — [बिज़नेस] — [महीना साल]

| | इस महीने | पिछला महीना | पिछले साल यही महीना |
|---|---|---|---|
| बिक्री (GST छोड़कर) | | | |
| माल/raw material लागत | | | |
| Gross profit (margin %) | | | |
| चालू ख़र्च | | | |
| Drawings से पहले net profit (margin %) | | | |
| Drawings | | | |
| Commission/charges % | | | |

बड़े बदलाव: 1… 2… 3…
इस महीने breakeven बिक्री: ₹[ ] (fixed ख़र्च ₹[ ] ÷ gross margin [ ]%)
अगले महीने के 3 काम: ...
Data की कमियाँ / [जाँचें]: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] बिक्री में GST collected और transfers शामिल नहीं।
- [ ] Drawings और loan principal ख़र्च में नहीं।
- [ ] हर % के साथ लिखा है कि किसका %।
- [ ] कारण अंदाज़े से नहीं; अनजान कारण चिह्नित।
- [ ] काम छोटी टीम एक महीने में कर सके ऐसे।

## Limits

- सिर्फ़ प्रबंधन के लिए; tax/accounting सलाह या formal statements नहीं।
- आँकड़े, industry benchmark या tax राशि नहीं गढ़ता; benchmark इस्तेमाल हो तो `[जाँचें]`।
- Cash basis और accrual basis में मुनाफ़ा अलग दिख सकता है; CA से पूछें।

skills.body:
# Tax Records Checklist (US small business)

Helps the owner hand the accountant a complete, organized pack instead of a shoebox. It lists what records to gather, checks for common gaps, and builds a calendar of dates to confirm with the CPA. It does not calculate tax or give tax advice.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- Year-end (December–January) prep, or before meeting your CPA/enrolled agent.
- A quarter ends and you want to check estimated tax and sales tax records.
- You received a letter from a tax agency and need to find records (then call your CPA).
- Setting up a record-keeping system for a new business.

Do not use when:
- Weekly entries are not done → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine`.
- Sorting transactions → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer`.
- Preparing or reviewing the return itself → your CPA; accountant skill `tax-return-preparation-review`.

## What to ask for first

1. Business structure: sole proprietor / single-member LLC (usually Schedule C), partnership, S-corp, C-corp [VERIFY with CPA].
2. State(s) where you sell or have staff; do you collect sales tax?
3. Employees (payroll provider?) and contractors paid this year.
4. Bookkeeping system and whether the year is fully reconciled.
5. Vehicles, home office, large equipment purchases, loans.
6. Estimated tax payments made this year.

## Steps

1. **Income records:** monthly P&L, bank statements for all 12 months, payment-processor annual summaries (Square/Stripe/PayPal; Form 1099-K if received), cash sales logs, 1099-NEC/MISC received from clients.
2. **Expense records:** categorized expense report; receipts for larger purchases and anything unusual; meals with business purpose noted; travel details.
3. **Vehicle:** mileage log (date, purpose, miles) or actual expense records; vehicle purchase documents.
4. **Home office:** square footage of office and home, rent/mortgage interest, utilities — CPA decides the method.
5. **Assets:** invoices for equipment, computers, furniture, vehicles bought this year (date in service, price).
6. **Contractors:** list each contractor, total paid, payment method, W-9 on file (name, address, TIN). Flag who may need a 1099-NEC (threshold has been $600; scheduled to change for 2026 payments [VERIFY]); filing/furnishing deadline is generally January 31 [VERIFY].
7. **Payroll:** year-end payroll reports, W-2/W-3, Forms 941/940 from your payroll provider.
8. **Sales tax:** each period's return filed and payment proof per state; compare sales tax collected in the books with amounts filed.
9. **Estimated taxes:** dates and amounts of federal and state estimated payments (Form 1040-ES or business equivalents).
10. **Loans and other:** loan statements (interest paid), insurance, licenses, prior-year return.
11. **Gap check:** months not reconciled, missing receipts, personal items in business accounts, contractors without W-9, sales tax mismatch. List each with a fix and owner.
12. **Key dates calendar** — list dates to confirm with the CPA (1099/W-2 deadline, return due date for your entity type, quarterly estimates, state sales tax dates). Mark every date [VERIFY].
13. **Record keeping:** keep tax records at least 3 years, longer in some cases (e.g., employment records 4 years, assets until sold plus years) [VERIFY with IRS guidance/CPA].

## Output format

```
Tax records pack — [Business] — tax year [YYYY] — entity: [ ] — CPA: [name]

| # | Item | Have it? (✓/✗/partial) | Where it is (folder/link) | Gap / fix | Owner | By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Contractors: name | total paid | method | W-9 ✓/✗ | 1099-NEC needed? [VERIFY]
Sales tax: period | collected per books | filed | difference
Estimated taxes paid: date | federal/state | amount
Key dates to confirm with CPA [VERIFY]: ...
Questions for CPA: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] All 12 months of statements are present for every business account.
- [ ] Every contractor paid is listed with W-9 status.
- [ ] Sales tax collected vs. filed is compared per state.
- [ ] Every date and threshold is marked [VERIFY], never presented as certain.
- [ ] No tax amounts or deductions are calculated or promised.

## Limits

- Not tax or legal advice. Your CPA or enrolled agent decides filings, deductions and deadlines.
- Never invents tax rates, thresholds, deadlines or amounts; tax law changes often (check IRS.gov and your state revenue site).
- Does not file anything or log into IRS or state portals.

skills.name: smallbiz-tax-records-checklist-ko
skills.description: 소상공인의 부가세 신고(1월·7월)와 종합소득세 신고(5월) 전에 세무사에게 넘길 자료를 점검합니다. 사업자 유형(간이·일반·면세), 매출 자료(카드·현금영수증·배달앱·스마트스토어), 세금계산서 발급·수취, 사업용 카드 홈택스 등록, 간편장부, 인건비·원천세, 차량·장비 구입 자료를 확인하고 빠진 것과 확인할 날짜를 정리합니다. "부가세 신고 준비", "종소세 자료", "세무사한테 뭐 줘야 해요", "홈택스 자료 챙기기" 같은 요청에 사용합니다.
skills.body:
# 세금 신고 자료 점검표

신고 철에 영수증 상자 대신 정리된 자료 묶음을 세무사에게 넘기도록 돕습니다. 모을 자료를 나열하고, 자주 빠지는 것을 점검하고, 세무사·홈택스로 확인할 날짜 목록을 만듭니다. 세액 계산이나 세무 자문은 하지 않습니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 부가세 확정신고(일반과세자: 1월, 7월 / 간이과세자: 1월) 전 `[확인 필요]`
- 종합소득세 신고(5월, 성실신고확인 대상은 6월) 전 `[확인 필요]`
- 세무서 안내문을 받아 자료를 찾아야 할 때(그 다음 세무사에게 연락)
- 새 사업의 자료 보관 체계를 만들 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 주간 정리가 안 됨 → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-ko`
- 거래 분류 → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`
- 신고서 작성·검토 → 세무사

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 사업자 유형: 간이과세자 / 일반과세자 / 면세사업자, 개인 / 법인
2. 장부 의무: 간편장부 대상자인지 복식부기 의무자인지(업종별 직전 연도 수입금액 기준) `[확인 필요]`
3. 직원(4대보험, 근로소득 원천징수)과 프리랜서(사업소득 3.3%) 지급 여부
4. 장부 방식(직접 간편장부, 경리 앱, 세무사 기장)
5. 업무용 차량, 큰 장비·인테리어 구입, 대출
6. 기한 내 신고·납부 이력, 중간예납(11월) 납부 여부 `[확인 필요]`

## 작성 절차

1. **매출 자료**: 카드 매출(카드사·VAN 자료, 홈택스 신용카드 매출자료 조회), 현금영수증 발행 내역, 배달앱·스마트스토어·오픈마켓 정산 내역, 계좌이체·현금 매출 기록, 발급한 세금계산서·계산서
2. **매입·지출 자료**: 받은 세금계산서·계산서(홈택스 조회), 사업용 카드 사용 내역(홈택스 등록 여부 확인), 지출증빙용 현금영수증, 간이영수증(금액 한도 주의 `[확인 필요]`)
3. **장부**: 간편장부 또는 기장 자료, 월별 통장 내역 12개월
4. **인건비**: 급여대장, 원천세 신고 내역, 4대보험 납부 내역, 프리랜서 지급 명세와 간이지급명세서 제출 여부 `[확인 필요]`
5. **자산**: 장비·인테리어·차량 구입 세금계산서(날짜, 금액)
6. **차량**: 업무용 차량이면 운행 기록 여부(필요 여부는 세무사 확인)
7. **기타**: 임대차계약서, 대출 이자 내역, 보험료, 노란우산공제 납입 증명 `[확인 필요]`, 지난해 신고서
8. **불일치 점검**: 홈택스 매출 자료와 장부 매출 차이, 세금계산서 발급 누락·지연, 증빙 없는 지출, 사업용 통장에 섞인 개인 거래, 현금영수증 미발급 현금 매출
9. **간이과세자 점검**: 연 매출이 간이과세 기준(최근 기준 연 1억 400만 원 미만 `[확인 필요]`)을 넘었는지, 넘으면 유형 전환과 세금계산서 발급 의무 변화를 세무사와 확인
10. **날짜 목록**: 부가세 신고·납부, 종합소득세, 원천세(매월 또는 반기), 간이지급명세서, 4대보험 — 모든 날짜에 `[확인 필요]` 표시
11. **보관**: 장부와 증빙은 보통 신고 기한부터 5년 보관 `[확인 필요]`

## 결과물 형식

```
신고 자료 묶음 — [상호] — [과세기간] — 유형: [간이/일반/면세] — 세무사: [이름]

| # | 자료 | 있음(✓/✗/일부) | 위치(폴더·홈택스 메뉴) | 빠진 것·조치 | 담당 | 기한 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

매출 대조: 홈택스 카드·현금영수증 합계 | 장부 매출 | 차이
세금계산서: 발급 [건] / 수취 [건] / 누락·지연 의심 [건]
인건비·외주비: 이름 | 금액 | 원천징수 ✓/✗
확인할 날짜 [확인 필요]: ...
세무사 질문: ...
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 모든 사업용 계좌의 12개월(또는 과세기간) 내역이 있는가
- [ ] 홈택스 매출 자료와 장부 매출을 대조했는가
- [ ] 세금계산서 발급·수취 누락을 점검했는가
- [ ] 모든 날짜와 기준 금액에 `[확인 필요]`를 붙였는가
- [ ] 세액이나 공제를 계산하거나 약속하지 않았는가

## 한계

- 세무·법률 자문이 아닙니다. 신고, 공제, 기한은 세무사가 판단합니다.
- 세율, 기준 금액, 기한, 금액을 지어내지 않습니다. 세법은 자주 바뀌므로 국세청·홈택스 안내를 확인합니다.
- 홈택스에 로그인하거나 신고를 대신하지 않습니다.

# 세금 신고 자료 점검표

신고 철에 영수증 상자 대신 정리된 자료 묶음을 세무사에게 넘기도록 돕습니다. 모을 자료를 나열하고, 자주 빠지는 것을 점검하고, 세무사·홈택스로 확인할 날짜 목록을 만듭니다. 세액 계산이나 세무 자문은 하지 않습니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 부가세 확정신고(일반과세자: 1월, 7월 / 간이과세자: 1월) 전 `[확인 필요]`
- 종합소득세 신고(5월, 성실신고확인 대상은 6월) 전 `[확인 필요]`
- 세무서 안내문을 받아 자료를 찾아야 할 때(그 다음 세무사에게 연락)
- 새 사업의 자료 보관 체계를 만들 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 주간 정리가 안 됨 → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-ko`
- 거래 분류 → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`
- 신고서 작성·검토 → 세무사

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 사업자 유형: 간이과세자 / 일반과세자 / 면세사업자, 개인 / 법인
2. 장부 의무: 간편장부 대상자인지 복식부기 의무자인지(업종별 직전 연도 수입금액 기준) `[확인 필요]`
3. 직원(4대보험, 근로소득 원천징수)과 프리랜서(사업소득 3.3%) 지급 여부
4. 장부 방식(직접 간편장부, 경리 앱, 세무사 기장)
5. 업무용 차량, 큰 장비·인테리어 구입, 대출
6. 기한 내 신고·납부 이력, 중간예납(11월) 납부 여부 `[확인 필요]`

## 작성 절차

1. **매출 자료**: 카드 매출(카드사·VAN 자료, 홈택스 신용카드 매출자료 조회), 현금영수증 발행 내역, 배달앱·스마트스토어·오픈마켓 정산 내역, 계좌이체·현금 매출 기록, 발급한 세금계산서·계산서
2. **매입·지출 자료**: 받은 세금계산서·계산서(홈택스 조회), 사업용 카드 사용 내역(홈택스 등록 여부 확인), 지출증빙용 현금영수증, 간이영수증(금액 한도 주의 `[확인 필요]`)
3. **장부**: 간편장부 또는 기장 자료, 월별 통장 내역 12개월
4. **인건비**: 급여대장, 원천세 신고 내역, 4대보험 납부 내역, 프리랜서 지급 명세와 간이지급명세서 제출 여부 `[확인 필요]`
5. **자산**: 장비·인테리어·차량 구입 세금계산서(날짜, 금액)
6. **차량**: 업무용 차량이면 운행 기록 여부(필요 여부는 세무사 확인)
7. **기타**: 임대차계약서, 대출 이자 내역, 보험료, 노란우산공제 납입 증명 `[확인 필요]`, 지난해 신고서
8. **불일치 점검**: 홈택스 매출 자료와 장부 매출 차이, 세금계산서 발급 누락·지연, 증빙 없는 지출, 사업용 통장에 섞인 개인 거래, 현금영수증 미발급 현금 매출
9. **간이과세자 점검**: 연 매출이 간이과세 기준(최근 기준 연 1억 400만 원 미만 `[확인 필요]`)을 넘었는지, 넘으면 유형 전환과 세금계산서 발급 의무 변화를 세무사와 확인
10. **날짜 목록**: 부가세 신고·납부, 종합소득세, 원천세(매월 또는 반기), 간이지급명세서, 4대보험 — 모든 날짜에 `[확인 필요]` 표시
11. **보관**: 장부와 증빙은 보통 신고 기한부터 5년 보관 `[확인 필요]`

## 결과물 형식

```
신고 자료 묶음 — [상호] — [과세기간] — 유형: [간이/일반/면세] — 세무사: [이름]

| # | 자료 | 있음(✓/✗/일부) | 위치(폴더·홈택스 메뉴) | 빠진 것·조치 | 담당 | 기한 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

매출 대조: 홈택스 카드·현금영수증 합계 | 장부 매출 | 차이
세금계산서: 발급 [건] / 수취 [건] / 누락·지연 의심 [건]
인건비·외주비: 이름 | 금액 | 원천징수 ✓/✗
확인할 날짜 [확인 필요]: ...
세무사 질문: ...
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 모든 사업용 계좌의 12개월(또는 과세기간) 내역이 있는가
- [ ] 홈택스 매출 자료와 장부 매출을 대조했는가
- [ ] 세금계산서 발급·수취 누락을 점검했는가
- [ ] 모든 날짜와 기준 금액에 `[확인 필요]`를 붙였는가
- [ ] 세액이나 공제를 계산하거나 약속하지 않았는가

## 한계

- 세무·법률 자문이 아닙니다. 신고, 공제, 기한은 세무사가 판단합니다.
- 세율, 기준 금액, 기한, 금액을 지어내지 않습니다. 세법은 자주 바뀌므로 국세청·홈택스 안내를 확인합니다.
- 홈택스에 로그인하거나 신고를 대신하지 않습니다.

# Tax Records Checklist (GST और ITR records)

मालिक को CA के पास थैले भर bills की जगह व्यवस्थित pack ले जाने में मदद करता है। कौन-से records इकट्ठा करने हैं, आम कमियाँ कौन-सी हैं, और कौन-सी तारीख़ें CA/GST portal से confirm करनी हैं — यह सब बताता है। Tax की गणना या tax सलाह नहीं देता।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- हर महीने/quarter GST return से पहले।
- साल ख़त्म होने पर (मार्च–जुलाई) ITR और audit की तैयारी।
- GST या income tax notice आया हो और records ढूँढने हों (फिर CA से बात)।
- नए बिज़नेस का record-keeping system बनाना हो।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- हफ़्ते का हिसाब नहीं हुआ → `smallbiz-weekly-bookkeeping-routine-hi`
- Entries की category → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-hi`
- Return भरना/जाँचना → CA

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. बिज़नेस का ढाँचा: proprietorship, partnership/LLP, company।
2. GST: registered नहीं (turnover सीमा से कम — goods के लिए आम तौर पर ₹40 लाख, services ₹20 लाख, कुछ राज्यों में कम `[जाँचें]`), regular, या composition (सीमा आम तौर पर ₹1.5 करोड़ `[जाँचें]`)। Return monthly या QRMP?
3. Income tax: सामान्य books या presumptive (44AD व्यापार / 44ADA professionals) `[जाँचें]`।
4. स्टाफ़ (PF/ESI), contractors/professionals को भुगतान (TDS)।
5. Software: Tally, Vyapar, Zoho, Excel; साल पूरा मिलाया गया?
6. बड़ी ख़रीद (machine, गाड़ी, furniture), loans, Udyam registration।

## Steps

1. **बिक्री records:** सारे tax invoices / bills of supply, credit/debit notes, online platform reports (Amazon/Flipkart/Swiggy — TCS सहित), UPI/POS settlement, cash बिक्री register।
2. **GST मिलान:** books की बिक्री = GSTR-1; GSTR-3B में भरा tax = books; purchase bills ↔ GSTR-2B (जो supplier ने upload नहीं किया उसकी list)। Composition dealers: तिमाही CMP-08 और सालाना GSTR-4 `[जाँचें]`।
3. **ख़रीद/ख़र्च records:** supplier के GST invoices, बाक़ी bills, किराया agreement, बिजली bills।
4. **Bank और UPI:** सभी business accounts के 12 महीने के statements; बड़ी cash जमा/निकासी के notes।
5. **Stock:** साल के अंत का stock (मात्रा और लागत), अगर व्यापार है।
6. **TDS/TCS:** आपने काटा — challans, quarterly returns (24Q/26Q), deductees के PAN; आपका कटा — Form 26AS और AIS/TIS में दिख रहा है या नहीं, Form 16A।
7. **Salary:** salary register, PF/ESI challans (अगर लागू)।
8. **Assets:** machine/गाड़ी/computer के invoices (तारीख़, राशि)।
9. **अन्य:** loan statements (ब्याज़ certificate), insurance, licences, पिछले साल का ITR, advance tax challans।
10. **कमियाँ जाँचें:** मिलान न होने वाले महीने, ग़ायब bills, GSTR-2B में न दिखने वाले purchase, बिना invoice की बिक्री, बिज़नेस account में निजी entries, बिना PAN वाले भुगतान।
11. **तारीख़ों की list:** GSTR-1, GSTR-3B (या CMP-08/GSTR-4), TDS जमा और returns, advance tax किस्तें, ITR due date (audit हो या न हो) — हर तारीख़ पर `[जाँचें]`।
12. **Record रखना:** GST में books और records आम तौर पर annual return की due date से 72 महीने (6 साल) रखने होते हैं `[जाँचें]`।

## Output format

```
Tax records pack — [बिज़नेस] — FY [YYYY-YY] — GST: [regular/composition/नहीं] — CA: [नाम]

| # | Record | है? (✓/✗/आधा) | कहाँ (folder/portal) | कमी / उपाय | ज़िम्मेदार | कब तक |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

GST मिलान: महीना | books बिक्री | GSTR-1 | GSTR-3B tax | फ़र्क़
ITC: books purchase GST | GSTR-2B | फ़र्क़ (supplier list)
TDS: किसका | राशि | section [जाँचें] | जमा ✓/✗
Confirm करने वाली तारीख़ें [जाँचें]: ...
CA से सवाल: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] हर business account के 12 महीने के statements हैं।
- [ ] Books ↔ GSTR-1 ↔ GSTR-3B और purchase ↔ GSTR-2B मिलान हुआ।
- [ ] TDS कटौती और 26AS/AIS जाँचे गए।
- [ ] हर तारीख़ और सीमा पर `[जाँचें]`, पक्की बात की तरह नहीं।
- [ ] कोई tax राशि या छूट calculate या वादा नहीं।

## Limits

- Tax या legal सलाह नहीं। Return, छूट और तारीख़ें CA तय करेंगे।
- दरें, सीमाएँ, तारीख़ें या राशि नहीं गढ़ता; नियम अक्सर बदलते हैं — GST portal, CBIC और income tax portal देखें।
- किसी portal में login या filing नहीं करता।

9. **अन्य:** loan statements (ब्याज़ certificate), insurance, licences, पिछले साल का ITR, advance tax challans।
10. **कमियाँ जाँचें:** मिलान न होने वाले महीने, ग़ायब bills, GSTR-2B में न दिखने वाले purchase, बिना invoice की बिक्री, बिज़नेस account में निजी entries, बिना PAN वाले भुगतान।
11. **तारीख़ों की list:** GSTR-1, GSTR-3B (या CMP-08/GSTR-4), TDS जमा और returns, advance tax किस्तें, ITR due date (audit हो या न हो) — हर तारीख़ पर `[जाँचें]`।
12. **Record रखना:** GST में books और records आम तौर पर annual return की due date से 72 महीने (6 साल) रखने होते हैं `[जाँचें]`।

## Output format

```
Tax records pack — [बिज़नेस] — FY [YYYY-YY] — GST: [regular/composition/नहीं] — CA: [नाम]

| # | Record | है? (✓/✗/आधा) | कहाँ (folder/portal) | कमी / उपाय | ज़िम्मेदार | कब तक |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

GST मिलान: महीना | books बिक्री | GSTR-1 | GSTR-3B tax | फ़र्क़
ITC: books purchase GST | GSTR-2B | फ़र्क़ (supplier list)
TDS: किसका | राशि | section [जाँचें] | जमा ✓/✗
Confirm करने वाली तारीख़ें [जाँचें]: ...
CA से सवाल: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] हर business account के 12 महीने के statements हैं।
- [ ] Books ↔ GSTR-1 ↔ GSTR-3B और purchase ↔ GSTR-2B मिलान हुआ।
- [ ] TDS कटौती और 26AS/AIS जाँचे गए।
- [ ] हर तारीख़ और सीमा पर `[जाँचें]`, पक्की बात की तरह नहीं।
- [ ] कोई tax राशि या छूट calculate या वादा नहीं।

## Limits

- Tax या legal सलाह नहीं। Return, छूट और तारीख़ें CA तय करेंगे।
- दरें, सीमाएँ, तारीख़ें या राशि नहीं गढ़ता; नियम अक्सर बदलते हैं — GST portal, CBIC और income tax portal देखें।
- किसी portal में login या filing नहीं करता।

skills.description: Runs a simple 30–60 minute weekly bookkeeping routine for a small business owner — collect receipts, match bank and card transactions in QuickBooks/Xero/Wave or a spreadsheet, record cash sales, separate business and personal spending, check unpaid invoices and bills, and note sales tax collected — then produces a one-page weekly summary. Use for "do my books this week", "weekly bookkeeping checklist", "I'm behind on my books", or "help me catch up on receipts".
skills.body:
# Weekly Bookkeeping Routine

Small businesses get into trouble when bookkeeping waits until tax time. This skill turns it into a short weekly habit with the same steps every week, so the owner always knows how much money came in, what went out, who owes them and what they owe — and has clean records for the accountant.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- Doing the weekly "books hour" (Friday afternoon or Monday morning).
- Catching up after several weeks of not doing it (run once per missed week, oldest first).
- Training a family member or part-time staff member to do the books.

Do not use when:
- You only need to sort a pile of expenses into categories → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer`.
- You want to see if the month made money → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check`.
- You want to see if cash will run short in coming weeks → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week`.
- You are getting ready for tax filing → `smallbiz-tax-records-checklist`.
- Full month-end close for a larger company → accountant skill `month-end-close-tracker`.

## What to ask for first

1. Where the books live: QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, FreshBooks, a spreadsheet, or nothing yet.
2. Accounts to check: business bank, business card(s), PayPal/Square/Stripe/Venmo business, cash drawer.
3. Which week (dates) and whether earlier weeks are done.
4. Do you collect sales tax? In which state(s)? How often do you file?
5. Do you pay contractors (possible 1099-NEC later) or employees (payroll provider)?

If they have no system yet, suggest a simple spreadsheet with the columns in the output format and say a bookkeeping app can come later.

## Steps

1. **Gather (10 min).** Download or open the week's bank, card and payment-app transactions. Photograph paper receipts and put them in one folder named by month.
2. **Record sales.** Make sure every sale is in: card/payment-app deposits, cash sales (from the register or daily cash sheet), checks deposited. Note processor fees separately — deposits are often net of fees.
3. **Match and categorize spending.** For each transaction, attach a receipt and pick a category (see `smallbiz-expense-categorizer`). Write a short note for anything unusual ("lunch with client Jane Doe — new project").
4. **Separate personal items.** Anything personal paid from the business account is recorded as an owner draw (not an expense). Anything business paid personally is noted for reimbursement or owner contribution.
5. **Check money owed to you.** List unpaid invoices and how many days overdue → hand off to `smallbiz-receivables-aging-review` or `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence` if needed.
6. **Check bills you owe.** List bills due in the next 2 weeks.
7. **Sales tax set-aside.** If you collect sales tax, total what was collected this week and move it to a separate savings account; it is not your money. Note the next filing date [VERIFY with your state].
8. **Contractor tracking.** Note payments to each contractor and whether you have their W-9 on file.
9. **Reconcile balance.** Does the bookkeeping balance match the real bank balance at week end? If not, list the difference and likely causes (missing transaction, duplicate, pending item).
10. **Write the one-page summary** (below) and file it.

## Output format

```
Weekly books — [Business] — week of [date] to [date]
Money in: $[ ]  (card/app $[ ], cash $[ ], checks $[ ])
Money out: $[ ]  Top 3 spending categories: ...
Bank balance (real): $[ ]  Books balance: $[ ]  Difference: $[ ] — reason: ...
Sales tax collected this week: $[ ] → moved to tax savings: yes/no
Unpaid invoices: [count] totaling $[ ] (oldest: [days])
Bills due next 14 days: ...
Receipts missing: [list]
Owner questions for the accountant: ...
Done by: [name]  Time spent: [ ]
```

Plus, if no software: a transaction log table — Date | Description | Money in | Money out | Category | Receipt? | Notes.

## Quality checks

- [ ] Every transaction this week has a category and (for spending over your chosen amount) a receipt.
- [ ] Books balance equals the real bank balance, or the difference is explained.
- [ ] Personal and business items are separated.
- [ ] Sales tax collected is tracked separately from sales.
- [ ] Numbers come only from the owner's statements — nothing estimated without saying so.

## Limits

- Not tax or accounting advice. Your CPA or enrolled agent decides how items are treated on Schedule C or other returns.
- Never invents amounts, tax rates or filing dates; state sales-tax rules differ widely — confirm with your state revenue department [VERIFY].
- Does not log into bank accounts; works from statements or exports the owner provides.

skills.description: 소상공인 사장님이 매주 30~60분 안에 끝내는 장부 정리 루틴입니다. 영수증 모으기, 사업용 통장·카드 내역 맞추기, 카드·현금·배달앱·계좌이체 매출 기록, 개인 지출 분리, 받을 돈·줄 돈 확인, 부가세 따로 떼어 두기, 세금계산서·현금영수증 발행 누락 점검을 하고 한 장짜리 주간 요약을 만듭니다. "이번 주 장부 정리", "간편장부 쓰는 법", "장부 밀렸어요", "영수증 정리 도와줘" 같은 요청에 사용합니다.
skills.body:
# 주간 장부 정리 루틴

장부를 세금 신고 때까지 미루면 꼭 문제가 생깁니다. 이 스킬은 장부 정리를 매주 같은 순서로 하는 짧은 습관으로 만들어, 사장님이 들어온 돈·나간 돈·받을 돈·줄 돈을 늘 알고 세무사에게 깔끔한 자료를 넘길 수 있게 합니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 매주 정해진 "장부 시간"(금요일 오후, 월요일 오전 등)
- 몇 주 밀린 장부를 따라잡을 때(오래된 주부터 한 주씩)
- 가족이나 아르바이트 직원에게 장부 정리를 맡길 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 지출 분류만 필요 → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`
- 이번 달 남았는지 확인 → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-ko`
- 앞으로 돈이 모자랄지 확인 → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-ko`
- 부가세·종합소득세 신고 준비 → `smallbiz-tax-records-checklist-ko`
- 큰 회사의 월 결산 → 회계사용 스킬 `month-end-close-tracker-ko`

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 장부를 어디에 쓰는지: 간편장부 엑셀, 경리 앱(예: 캐시노트·자비스 등), 세무사 사무실 전달용 자료, 아직 없음
2. 확인할 계좌: 사업용 통장, 사업용 카드(홈택스 등록 여부), 카드 단말기(VAN)·배달앱·스마트스토어 정산, 현금
3. 대상 주(날짜)와 이전 주 정리 여부
4. 사업자 유형: 간이과세자 / 일반과세자 / 면세사업자
5. 직원(4대보험, 원천세)이나 프리랜서(3.3% 원천징수) 지급 여부

시스템이 없으면 아래 결과물 형식의 열로 엑셀 장부를 쓰자고 제안합니다.

## 작성 절차

1. **모으기(10분)**: 이번 주 통장·카드·정산 내역을 내려받습니다. 종이 영수증은 사진을 찍어 월별 폴더에 넣습니다.
2. **매출 기록**: 카드 매출, 배달앱·스마트스토어 정산금, 계좌이체, 현금 매출을 빠짐없이 적습니다. 정산금은 수수료가 빠진 금액일 수 있으니 매출과 수수료를 나눠 적습니다.
3. **현금영수증·세금계산서 점검**: 현금 매출에 현금영수증을 발급했는지, 사업자 고객에게 세금계산서를 발급했는지 확인합니다. 현금영수증 의무발행업종은 일정 금액 이상 거래에 고객 요청이 없어도 발급해야 합니다 `[확인 필요]`. 세금계산서는 보통 공급한 달의 다음 달 10일까지 발급합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
4. **지출 맞추기·분류**: 거래마다 증빙(세금계산서, 카드 전표, 현금영수증)을 붙이고 분류합니다(`smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`). 특이한 지출은 메모합니다("거래처 홍길동 대표 식사 — 신규 납품 상담").
5. **개인 지출 분리**: 사업용 통장에서 나간 개인 지출은 비용이 아니라 "대표 인출"로 적습니다.
6. **받을 돈 확인**: 미수금 목록과 경과 일수 → 필요하면 `smallbiz-receivables-aging-review-ko`, `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-ko`
7. **줄 돈 확인**: 2주 안에 낼 거래처 대금, 임대료, 공과금
8. **부가세 떼어 두기**: 일반과세자라면 이번 주 매출에 포함된 부가세(대략 공급가액의 10%)를 별도 통장으로 옮겨 둡니다. 내 돈이 아닙니다. 간이과세자는 계산 방식이 다르니 세무사에게 비율을 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
9. **잔액 맞추기**: 장부 잔액과 실제 통장 잔액이 같은지 확인하고, 다르면 차이와 원인을 적습니다.
10. **한 장 요약** 작성 후 보관

## 결과물 형식

```
주간 장부 — [상호] — [시작일]~[종료일]
들어온 돈: [ ]원 (카드 [ ], 배달앱·온라인 [ ], 계좌이체 [ ], 현금 [ ])
나간 돈: [ ]원  큰 지출 3가지: ...
실제 통장 잔액: [ ]원  장부 잔액: [ ]원  차이: [ ]원 — 원인: ...
부가세 적립: [ ]원 → 별도 통장 이체: 예/아니요
현금영수증·세금계산서 발급 누락: [건수]
미수금: [건수] 합계 [ ]원 (가장 오래된 것 [ ]일)
2주 내 낼 돈: ...
없는 증빙: [목록]
세무사에게 물을 것: ...
작성: [이름]  소요 시간: [ ]
```

시스템이 없을 때 거래 기록표: 날짜 | 내용 | 들어온 돈 | 나간 돈 | 분류 | 증빙 종류 | 메모

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 이번 주 모든 거래에 분류와 증빙이 있는가
- [ ] 장부 잔액이 통장 잔액과 같거나 차이가 설명되었는가
- [ ] 개인 지출과 사업 지출이 나뉘었는가
- [ ] 부가세 몫이 매출과 따로 관리되는가
- [ ] 숫자는 사장님 자료에서만 나왔는가

## 한계

- 세무·회계 자문이 아닙니다. 간편장부 대상 여부, 비용 인정 여부는 세무사가 판단합니다.
- 금액, 세율, 신고 기한을 지어내지 않습니다. 기준은 국세청·홈택스 안내로 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
- 홈택스나 은행에 로그인하지 않으며, 사장님이 준 내역으로만 작업합니다.

# 주간 장부 정리 루틴

장부를 세금 신고 때까지 미루면 꼭 문제가 생깁니다. 이 스킬은 장부 정리를 매주 같은 순서로 하는 짧은 습관으로 만들어, 사장님이 들어온 돈·나간 돈·받을 돈·줄 돈을 늘 알고 세무사에게 깔끔한 자료를 넘길 수 있게 합니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 매주 정해진 "장부 시간"(금요일 오후, 월요일 오전 등)
- 몇 주 밀린 장부를 따라잡을 때(오래된 주부터 한 주씩)
- 가족이나 아르바이트 직원에게 장부 정리를 맡길 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 지출 분류만 필요 → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`
- 이번 달 남았는지 확인 → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-ko`
- 앞으로 돈이 모자랄지 확인 → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-ko`
- 부가세·종합소득세 신고 준비 → `smallbiz-tax-records-checklist-ko`
- 큰 회사의 월 결산 → 회계사용 스킬 `month-end-close-tracker-ko`

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 장부를 어디에 쓰는지: 간편장부 엑셀, 경리 앱(예: 캐시노트·자비스 등), 세무사 사무실 전달용 자료, 아직 없음
2. 확인할 계좌: 사업용 통장, 사업용 카드(홈택스 등록 여부), 카드 단말기(VAN)·배달앱·스마트스토어 정산, 현금
3. 대상 주(날짜)와 이전 주 정리 여부
4. 사업자 유형: 간이과세자 / 일반과세자 / 면세사업자
5. 직원(4대보험, 원천세)이나 프리랜서(3.3% 원천징수) 지급 여부

시스템이 없으면 아래 결과물 형식의 열로 엑셀 장부를 쓰자고 제안합니다.

## 작성 절차

1. **모으기(10분)**: 이번 주 통장·카드·정산 내역을 내려받습니다. 종이 영수증은 사진을 찍어 월별 폴더에 넣습니다.
2. **매출 기록**: 카드 매출, 배달앱·스마트스토어 정산금, 계좌이체, 현금 매출을 빠짐없이 적습니다. 정산금은 수수료가 빠진 금액일 수 있으니 매출과 수수료를 나눠 적습니다.
3. **현금영수증·세금계산서 점검**: 현금 매출에 현금영수증을 발급했는지, 사업자 고객에게 세금계산서를 발급했는지 확인합니다. 현금영수증 의무발행업종은 일정 금액 이상 거래에 고객 요청이 없어도 발급해야 합니다 `[확인 필요]`. 세금계산서는 보통 공급한 달의 다음 달 10일까지 발급합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
4. **지출 맞추기·분류**: 거래마다 증빙(세금계산서, 카드 전표, 현금영수증)을 붙이고 분류합니다(`smallbiz-expense-categorizer-ko`). 특이한 지출은 메모합니다("거래처 홍길동 대표 식사 — 신규 납품 상담").
5. **개인 지출 분리**: 사업용 통장에서 나간 개인 지출은 비용이 아니라 "대표 인출"로 적습니다.
6. **받을 돈 확인**: 미수금 목록과 경과 일수 → 필요하면 `smallbiz-receivables-aging-review-ko`, `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-ko`
7. **줄 돈 확인**: 2주 안에 낼 거래처 대금, 임대료, 공과금
8. **부가세 떼어 두기**: 일반과세자라면 이번 주 매출에 포함된 부가세(대략 공급가액의 10%)를 별도 통장으로 옮겨 둡니다. 내 돈이 아닙니다. 간이과세자는 계산 방식이 다르니 세무사에게 비율을 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
9. **잔액 맞추기**: 장부 잔액과 실제 통장 잔액이 같은지 확인하고, 다르면 차이와 원인을 적습니다.
10. **한 장 요약** 작성 후 보관

## 결과물 형식

```
주간 장부 — [상호] — [시작일]~[종료일]
들어온 돈: [ ]원 (카드 [ ], 배달앱·온라인 [ ], 계좌이체 [ ], 현금 [ ])
나간 돈: [ ]원  큰 지출 3가지: ...
실제 통장 잔액: [ ]원  장부 잔액: [ ]원  차이: [ ]원 — 원인: ...
부가세 적립: [ ]원 → 별도 통장 이체: 예/아니요
현금영수증·세금계산서 발급 누락: [건수]
미수금: [건수] 합계 [ ]원 (가장 오래된 것 [ ]일)
2주 내 낼 돈: ...
없는 증빙: [목록]
세무사에게 물을 것: ...
작성: [이름]  소요 시간: [ ]
```

시스템이 없을 때 거래 기록표: 날짜 | 내용 | 들어온 돈 | 나간 돈 | 분류 | 증빙 종류 | 메모

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 이번 주 모든 거래에 분류와 증빙이 있는가
- [ ] 장부 잔액이 통장 잔액과 같거나 차이가 설명되었는가
- [ ] 개인 지출과 사업 지출이 나뉘었는가
- [ ] 부가세 몫이 매출과 따로 관리되는가
- [ ] 숫자는 사장님 자료에서만 나왔는가

## 한계

- 세무·회계 자문이 아닙니다. 간편장부 대상 여부, 비용 인정 여부는 세무사가 판단합니다.
- 금액, 세율, 신고 기한을 지어내지 않습니다. 기준은 국세청·홈택스 안내로 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
- 홈택스나 은행에 로그인하지 않으며, 사장님이 준 내역으로만 작업합니다.

# Weekly Bookkeeping Routine (हफ़्ते का हिसाब-किताब)

हिसाब को GST return या ITR के समय तक टालने से परेशानी होती है। यह skill हर हफ़्ते एक जैसे steps वाली छोटी आदत बनाता है, ताकि मालिक को हमेशा पता रहे कि कितना पैसा आया, कितना गया, किसने देना है और आपको किसे देना है — और CA/accountant को साफ़ records मिलें।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- हफ़्ते का "हिसाब का समय" (शनिवार शाम या सोमवार सुबह)।
- कई हफ़्ते पीछे रह गए हों (सबसे पुराने हफ़्ते से, एक-एक कर)।
- परिवार के सदस्य या part-time स्टाफ़ को हिसाब सिखाना हो।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- सिर्फ़ ख़र्चों को categories में बाँटना है → `smallbiz-expense-categorizer-hi`
- महीने में मुनाफ़ा हुआ या नहीं → `smallbiz-monthly-profit-check-hi`
- आगे cash कम पड़ेगा या नहीं → `smallbiz-cash-flow-13-week-hi`
- GST/ITR की तैयारी → `smallbiz-tax-records-checklist-hi`

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. हिसाब कहाँ रखते हैं: Tally, Vyapar, Khatabook, Zoho Books, Excel, या अभी कुछ नहीं।
2. कौन-से accounts: current account, UPI business QR, card machine (POS), Amazon/Swiggy/Zomato settlement, cash गल्ला।
3. कौन-सा हफ़्ता (तारीख़ें), पिछले हफ़्ते हो चुके हैं?
4. GST registration है? Regular या composition? GSTR-1/3B monthly या quarterly (QRMP)?
5. स्टाफ़ salary या contractors/professionals को भुगतान (TDS लग सकता है)?

कोई system नहीं है तो नीचे के columns वाली Excel sheet से शुरू करने का सुझाव दें।

## Steps

1. **इकट्ठा करें (10 मिनट):** हफ़्ते का bank statement, UPI app का settlement/report, POS report डाउनलोड करें। काग़ज़ी bills की photo लेकर महीने के folder में रखें।
2. **बिक्री लिखें:** UPI, card, cash, online platform settlement, cheque — सब। Platform settlement अक्सर commission काटकर आता है; बिक्री और commission अलग लिखें।
3. **Bill/invoice जाँच:** GST registered हैं तो हर बिक्री का tax invoice (या composition में bill of supply) बना या नहीं; B2B ग्राहकों के GSTIN सही हैं या नहीं।
4. **ख़र्च मिलाएँ और category दें:** हर entry के साथ bill (supplier का GST invoice हो तो input tax credit के काम आता है) और category (`smallbiz-expense-categorizer-hi`)। अजीब entry पर note ("supplier राम शर्मा को advance")।
5. **निजी ख़र्च अलग:** बिज़नेस account से घर का ख़र्च = "drawings", ख़र्च नहीं।
6. **उधारी (लेना है):** pending bills और कितने दिन हुए → ज़रूरत हो तो `smallbiz-receivables-aging-review-hi` या `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-hi`।
7. **देनदारी:** अगले 2 हफ़्ते में supplier, किराया, बिजली, EMI।
8. **GST अलग रखें:** Regular dealer हैं तो इस हफ़्ते की बिक्री पर लिया GST अलग account में डालें — यह आपका पैसा नहीं। Composition में दर अलग है; CA से confirm करें `[जाँचें]`।
9. **Balance मिलाएँ:** books का balance = असली bank balance? नहीं तो फ़र्क़ और कारण।
10. **एक पेज summary** लिखकर रखें।

## Output format

```
Weekly हिसाब — [बिज़नेस] — [तारीख़] से [तारीख़]
आया: ₹[ ] (UPI ₹[ ], card ₹[ ], cash ₹[ ], online platform ₹[ ])
गया: ₹[ ]  सबसे बड़े 3 ख़र्च: ...
असली bank balance: ₹[ ]  books balance: ₹[ ]  फ़र्क़: ₹[ ] — कारण: ...
GST collected इस हफ़्ते: ₹[ ] → अलग account में: हाँ/नहीं
बिना invoice की बिक्री: [संख्या]
उधारी: [संख्या] bills, कुल ₹[ ] (सबसे पुराना [ ] दिन)
अगले 14 दिन की देनदारी: ...
ग़ायब bills: [list]
CA से पूछना है: ...
किसने किया: [नाम]  समय: [ ]
```

Software नहीं तो entry log: तारीख़ | विवरण | आया | गया | category | bill है? | note

## Quality checks

- [ ] हफ़्ते की हर entry की category और (तय राशि से ऊपर) bill है।
- [ ] Books balance = bank balance, या फ़र्क़ समझाया गया।
- [ ] निजी और बिज़नेस अलग।
- [ ] GST collected बिक्री से अलग track हुआ।
- [ ] आँकड़े सिर्फ़ मालिक के statements से।

## Limits

- यह tax या accounting सलाह नहीं है; treatment CA तय करेंगे।
- राशि, GST दर या due date नहीं गढ़ता; GST portal/CA से confirm करें `[जाँचें]`।
- Bank या GST portal में login नहीं करता; मालिक के दिए statements से काम करता है।

8. **GST अलग रखें:** Regular dealer हैं तो इस हफ़्ते की बिक्री पर लिया GST अलग account में डालें — यह आपका पैसा नहीं। Composition में दर अलग है; CA से confirm करें `[जाँचें]`।
9. **Balance मिलाएँ:** books का balance = असली bank balance? नहीं तो फ़र्क़ और कारण।
10. **एक पेज summary** लिखकर रखें।

## Output format

```
Weekly हिसाब — [बिज़नेस] — [तारीख़] से [तारीख़]
आया: ₹[ ] (UPI ₹[ ], card ₹[ ], cash ₹[ ], online platform ₹[ ])
गया: ₹[ ]  सबसे बड़े 3 ख़र्च: ...
असली bank balance: ₹[ ]  books balance: ₹[ ]  फ़र्क़: ₹[ ] — कारण: ...
GST collected इस हफ़्ते: ₹[ ] → अलग account में: हाँ/नहीं
बिना invoice की बिक्री: [संख्या]
उधारी: [संख्या] bills, कुल ₹[ ] (सबसे पुराना [ ] दिन)
अगले 14 दिन की देनदारी: ...
ग़ायब bills: [list]
CA से पूछना है: ...
किसने किया: [नाम]  समय: [ ]
```

Software नहीं तो entry log: तारीख़ | विवरण | आया | गया | category | bill है? | note

## Quality checks

- [ ] हफ़्ते की हर entry की category और (तय राशि से ऊपर) bill है।
- [ ] Books balance = bank balance, या फ़र्क़ समझाया गया।
- [ ] निजी और बिज़नेस अलग।
- [ ] GST collected बिक्री से अलग track हुआ।
- [ ] आँकड़े सिर्फ़ मालिक के statements से।

## Limits

- यह tax या accounting सलाह नहीं है; treatment CA तय करेंगे।
- राशि, GST दर या due date नहीं गढ़ता; GST portal/CA से confirm करें `[जाँचें]`।
- Bank या GST portal में login नहीं करता; मालिक के दिए statements से काम करता है।

skills.body:
# Deposit and Payment Terms

Clear terms agreed before work starts prevent most payment problems. This skill helps the owner choose terms that fit the business, then writes them in short, plain wording that goes on quotes, invoices, booking pages and simple contracts.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- Starting to take deposits, or deposits are not covering material costs.
- Customers pay late or cancel last minute.
- Writing terms for a new quote template, booking page or service agreement.
- Reviewing terms once a year.

Do not use when:
- Applying the policy to one booking change → `smallbiz-booking-change-reply` (task answer-customers).
- Building an invoice → `smallbiz-invoice-builder`.
- A customer is already overdue → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence` or `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan`.
- You need a full legal contract → a lawyer; this produces a plain-language terms section.

## What to ask for first

1. What you sell (custom orders, appointments, projects, retail), typical job size and length.
2. Up-front costs per job (materials, booked time you cannot resell).
3. Current terms and what goes wrong (late payment, no-shows, scope arguments).
4. Customers: consumers, businesses, or both.
5. Payment methods and fees you are willing to absorb.
6. State(s) you operate in.

## Steps

1. **Deposit:** set it to cover at least your non-refundable costs (materials, reserved time). Typical patterns: custom products — deposit plus balance before delivery; projects — deposit then milestones; appointments — card on file or booking deposit. State whether the deposit is refundable, partly refundable or credited to a future booking. Some states limit deposits for certain trades (e.g., home improvement contractors) [VERIFY].
2. **Payment schedule:** for longer work, tie payments to milestones the customer can see ("after design approval", "on delivery").
3. **Due date:** pick one standard (due on receipt, Net 7, 15 or 30). Shorter is better for consumers and small jobs.
4. **Methods:** list accepted methods; decide whether you pass on card fees (card-surcharge rules differ by state and card network [VERIFY]) or offer a cash/ACH price.
5. **Late fee:** only if you are willing to apply it. State it clearly up front (e.g., flat fee or % per month after X days) and keep it within your state's limits [VERIFY]. It must be agreed before the work, not added later.
6. **Cancellation/rescheduling:** notice period, what is refunded, what is kept, and what happens if you cancel.
7. **Scope changes:** changes are quoted in writing before work → `smallbiz-scope-change-quote`.
8. **Write three versions:** one-line (booking page/invoice footer), short block (quote), and a fuller section (service agreement), all saying the same thing.
9. **Roll out:** where each version goes; tell existing regular customers before changing terms.

## Output format

```
Terms summary — [Business] — effective [date]
Deposit: [ ]% / $[ ] — refundable? [ ]   Schedule: [ ]
Due: [ ]   Methods: [ ]   Card fee policy: [ ] [VERIFY]
Late fee: [ ] [VERIFY state limit]   Cancellation: [ ]   Scope changes: [ ]

One-line version: ...
Quote/invoice block: ...
Service agreement section: ...
Where to place each: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Deposit covers non-refundable costs and refund rules are clear.
- [ ] All three versions say exactly the same thing.
- [ ] Late fee and card surcharge are flagged [VERIFY] for state rules.
- [ ] Language is plain; a customer could explain it back.
- [ ] Nothing contradicts existing booking or refund policies.

## Limits

- Not legal advice. Deposit limits, late-fee caps, surcharge rules and consumer cancellation rights (e.g., certain door-to-door sales cooling-off rules) vary; have important terms checked by a lawyer [VERIFY].
- Never invents percentages or legal limits; uses the owner's choices.

skills.description: 소상공인의 계약금(예약금)·중도금·잔금 비율, 결제 기한, 결제 수단, 지연 시 조건, 취소·환불 규정을 정하고 견적서·청구서·네이버 예약·카카오톡 안내·간단한 계약서에 넣을 쉬운 문구로 씁니다. "계약금 받아야 할까요", "결제 조건 문구", "예약금 환불 규정", "취소 수수료 정하기", "잔금을 늦게 줘요" 같은 요청에 사용합니다.
skills.body:
# 계약금·결제 조건 정하기

작업 전에 분명하게 합의한 조건이 대부분의 대금 문제를 막습니다. 이 스킬은 사장님 사업에 맞는 조건을 고르도록 돕고, 견적서·청구서·예약 페이지·간단한 계약서에 들어갈 짧고 쉬운 문구로 씁니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 계약금을 처음 받거나, 계약금으로 재료비가 안 될 때
- 잔금이 늦거나 당일 취소가 잦을 때
- 새 견적서 양식, 네이버 예약 안내, 서비스 계약서 문구를 쓸 때
- 1년에 한 번 조건을 점검할 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 예약 하나에 정책 적용 → `smallbiz-booking-change-reply-ko`
- 청구서 작성 → `smallbiz-invoice-builder-ko`
- 이미 밀린 미수금 → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-ko`, `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan-ko`
- 정식 계약서 전체 → 변호사·법무사. 이 스킬은 쉬운 조건 문구를 만듭니다.

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 판매 방식(주문 제작, 예약 서비스, 프로젝트, 매장 판매), 보통 작업 금액과 기간
2. 작업마다 먼저 드는 비용(재료, 다른 손님을 받을 수 없는 예약 시간)
3. 지금 조건과 자주 생기는 문제(잔금 지연, 노쇼, 범위 다툼)
4. 고객: 개인, 사업자, 둘 다
5. 결제 수단(계좌이체, 카드, 간편결제)과 감당할 수수료
6. 온라인·전화 판매 여부(전자상거래법상 청약철회 규정이 적용될 수 있음)

## 작성 절차

1. **계약금**: 최소한 돌려받을 수 없는 비용(재료, 예약 시간)을 덮도록 정합니다. 흔한 방식: 주문 제작 — 계약금 + 출고 전 잔금 / 프로젝트 — 계약금, 중도금, 잔금 / 예약 서비스 — 예약금. 환불 여부(전액, 일부, 다음 예약으로 이월)를 분명히 적습니다.
2. **단계별 결제**: 긴 작업은 고객이 확인할 수 있는 단계("시안 확정 후", "설치 완료 후")에 맞춥니다.
3. **결제 기한**: 하나의 기준(즉시, 7일, 15일, 30일, 익월 말). 개인 고객과 작은 작업은 짧게 합니다.
4. **결제 수단**: 받는 수단을 적습니다. 카드 결제 시 수수료를 고객에게 따로 받는 것은 여신전문금융업법상 가맹점 금지 행위에 해당할 수 있으니 하지 않습니다 `[확인 필요]`.
5. **지연 조건**: 실제로 적용할 생각이 있을 때만 정합니다. 미리 서면으로 합의하고, 과도한 지연손해금은 약관법상 무효가 될 수 있으므로 적정 수준을 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
6. **취소·일정 변경**: 통보 기한, 돌려주는 금액, 남기는 금액, 가게가 취소할 때의 처리. 공정거래위원회 「소비자분쟁해결기준」에 업종별 기준이 있으면 참고합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
7. **범위 변경**: 추가 작업은 작업 전에 서면으로 견적 → `smallbiz-scope-change-quote-ko`
8. **세 가지 버전 작성**: 한 줄(예약 안내·청구서 하단), 짧은 단락(견적서), 자세한 조항(계약서) — 내용이 모두 같아야 합니다.
9. **적용**: 어디에 넣을지 정하고, 단골에게는 바꾸기 전에 미리 알립니다.

## 결과물 형식

```
결제 조건 요약 — [상호] — 시행일 [ ]
계약금: [ ]% / [ ]원 — 환불: [ ]   단계: [ ]
기한: [ ]   결제 수단: [ ]   지연 조건: [ ] [확인 필요]
취소: [ ]   범위 변경: [ ]

한 줄 버전: ...
견적서·청구서 단락: ...
계약서 조항: ...
넣을 곳: 네이버 예약 안내 / 카카오톡 채널 / 견적서 / 청구서 / 계약서
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 계약금이 돌려받을 수 없는 비용을 덮고 환불 규정이 분명한가
- [ ] 세 버전 내용이 똑같은가
- [ ] 카드 수수료 전가, 과도한 위약금이 없는가
- [ ] 고객이 듣고 다시 설명할 수 있을 만큼 쉬운가
- [ ] 기존 예약·환불 정책과 부딪히지 않는가

## 한계

- 법률 자문이 아닙니다. 위약금·지연손해금의 적정 수준, 청약철회, 약관 규제는 업종과 판매 방식에 따라 다르므로 중요한 조건은 전문가 확인을 받습니다 `[확인 필요]`.
- 비율이나 법적 기준을 지어내지 않고 사장님의 선택을 씁니다.

2. **단계별 결제**: 긴 작업은 고객이 확인할 수 있는 단계("시안 확정 후", "설치 완료 후")에 맞춥니다.
3. **결제 기한**: 하나의 기준(즉시, 7일, 15일, 30일, 익월 말). 개인 고객과 작은 작업은 짧게 합니다.
4. **결제 수단**: 받는 수단을 적습니다. 카드 결제 시 수수료를 고객에게 따로 받는 것은 여신전문금융업법상 가맹점 금지 행위에 해당할 수 있으니 하지 않습니다 `[확인 필요]`.
5. **지연 조건**: 실제로 적용할 생각이 있을 때만 정합니다. 미리 서면으로 합의하고, 과도한 지연손해금은 약관법상 무효가 될 수 있으므로 적정 수준을 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
6. **취소·일정 변경**: 통보 기한, 돌려주는 금액, 남기는 금액, 가게가 취소할 때의 처리. 공정거래위원회 「소비자분쟁해결기준」에 업종별 기준이 있으면 참고합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
7. **범위 변경**: 추가 작업은 작업 전에 서면으로 견적 → `smallbiz-scope-change-quote-ko`
8. **세 가지 버전 작성**: 한 줄(예약 안내·청구서 하단), 짧은 단락(견적서), 자세한 조항(계약서) — 내용이 모두 같아야 합니다.
9. **적용**: 어디에 넣을지 정하고, 단골에게는 바꾸기 전에 미리 알립니다.

## 결과물 형식

```
결제 조건 요약 — [상호] — 시행일 [ ]
계약금: [ ]% / [ ]원 — 환불: [ ]   단계: [ ]
기한: [ ]   결제 수단: [ ]   지연 조건: [ ] [확인 필요]
취소: [ ]   범위 변경: [ ]

한 줄 버전: ...
견적서·청구서 단락: ...
계약서 조항: ...
넣을 곳: 네이버 예약 안내 / 카카오톡 채널 / 견적서 / 청구서 / 계약서
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 계약금이 돌려받을 수 없는 비용을 덮고 환불 규정이 분명한가
- [ ] 세 버전 내용이 똑같은가
- [ ] 카드 수수료 전가, 과도한 위약금이 없는가
- [ ] 고객이 듣고 다시 설명할 수 있을 만큼 쉬운가
- [ ] 기존 예약·환불 정책과 부딪히지 않는가

## 한계

- 비율이나 법적 기준을 지어내지 않고 사장님의 선택을 씁니다.

# Advance और Payment Terms

काम शुरू होने से पहले तय साफ़ शर्तें ज़्यादातर भुगतान झगड़े रोकती हैं। यह skill मालिक को बिज़नेस के हिसाब से शर्तें चुनने में मदद करता है और उन्हें quotation, invoice, WhatsApp message और सादे agreement के लिए छोटे, आसान शब्दों में लिखता है।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- पहली बार advance लेना शुरू करें, या advance से माल की लागत न निकले।
- ग्राहक देर से भुगतान करें या आख़िरी समय cancel करें।
- नया quotation format, booking message या service agreement लिखें।
- साल में एक बार terms की समीक्षा।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- एक booking पर policy लागू करनी है → `smallbiz-booking-change-reply-hi`
- Invoice बनाना → `smallbiz-invoice-builder-hi`
- पहले से उधारी → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-hi`, `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan-hi`
- पूरा legal contract → वकील; यह skill आसान भाषा की शर्तें बनाता है।

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. क्या बेचते हैं (custom order, appointment, project, दुकान बिक्री), आम काम की राशि और अवधि।
2. हर काम में पहले लगने वाला ख़र्च (माल, बुक किया समय)।
3. अभी की शर्तें और क्या दिक़्क़त आती है।
4. ग्राहक: आम लोग, बिज़नेस, या दोनों।
5. भुगतान तरीक़े और कौन-से charges आप उठा सकते हैं।
6. Udyam registration है या नहीं (B2B credit period के लिए)।

## Steps

1. **Advance:** कम से कम वह ख़र्च निकले जो वापस नहीं आता (माल, बुक किया समय)। आम तरीक़े: custom order — advance + delivery से पहले बाक़ी; project — advance, running bill, final; appointment — booking amount। Refund नियम साफ़: पूरा, कुछ, या अगली booking में adjust। GST registered हैं तो services के advance पर GST और receipt voucher के नियम CA से पूछें `[जाँचें]`।
2. **किस्तें:** लंबे काम में ग्राहक को दिखने वाले milestones ("design final होने पर", "fitting के बाद") से जोड़ें।
3. **Due date:** एक मानक (तुरंत, 7, 15, 30 दिन)। आम ग्राहकों और छोटे काम में छोटा रखें।
4. **MSME B2B:** Udyam registered micro/small supplier हैं तो लिखित credit period 45 दिन से ज़्यादा न रखें; बिना समझौते के 15 दिन माना जाता है; इससे MSMED Act का संरक्षण मिलता है, और ख़रीदार के लिए Income Tax की Section 43B(h) भी समय पर भुगतान का कारण बनती है `[जाँचें]`।
5. **तरीक़े:** UPI ID/QR, NEFT/RTGS, cheque (किसके नाम), cash (बड़ी cash राशि पर income tax की सीमाएँ हैं — Section 269ST `[जाँचें]`)।
6. **देर से भुगतान:** ब्याज़/late fee तभी लिखें जब सच में लगाएँगे; पहले से लिखित में तय करें।
7. **Cancellation/तारीख़ बदलना:** कितना पहले बताना है, क्या लौटेगा, क्या रखेंगे, और आप cancel करें तो क्या।
8. **Scope बदलाव:** अतिरिक्त काम से पहले लिखित quotation → `smallbiz-scope-change-quote-hi`
9. **तीन versions:** एक line (WhatsApp/invoice के नीचे), छोटा पैराग्राफ़ (quotation), पूरा clause (agreement) — तीनों में एक ही बात।
10. **लागू करें:** कहाँ लगाएँ; पुराने ग्राहकों को पहले बताएँ।

## Output format

```
Terms सार — [बिज़नेस] — लागू [तारीख़]
Advance: [ ]% / ₹[ ] — refund: [ ]   किस्तें: [ ]
Due: [ ]   तरीक़े: [ ]   देर पर: [ ] [जाँचें]
Cancellation: [ ]   Scope बदलाव: [ ]   MSME credit period: [ ] दिन

एक-line version: ...
Quotation/invoice पैराग्राफ़: ...
Agreement clause: ...
कहाँ लगाएँ: WhatsApp catalog/greeting / quotation / invoice / agreement
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Advance वापस न आने वाले ख़र्च को ढकता है और refund नियम साफ़ हैं।
- [ ] तीनों versions में एक जैसी बात।
- [ ] MSME credit period 45 दिन के भीतर (अगर लागू) और `[जाँचें]`।
- [ ] भाषा इतनी आसान कि ग्राहक दोहरा सके।
- [ ] मौजूदा booking/refund policy से टकराव नहीं।

## Limits

- Legal/tax सलाह नहीं। Consumer Protection Act की "unfair contract" शर्तें, GST on advance और cash सीमाएँ CA/वकील से जाँचें `[जाँचें]`।
- प्रतिशत या क़ानूनी सीमाएँ नहीं गढ़ता; मालिक के फ़ैसले लिखता है।

skills.name: smallbiz-invoice-builder
skills.description: Creates a clear, professional invoice for a US small business — business and customer details, invoice number, dates, line items, discounts, sales tax (only where it applies), deposit already paid, balance due, payment methods and payment terms including any agreed late fee — plus a short cover email or text. Use for "make an invoice", "invoice template", "bill this customer", "what should my invoice say", or "turn this quote into an invoice".
skills.body:
# Invoice Builder

An invoice that is clear gets paid faster. This skill builds an invoice the customer can understand at a glance — what they bought, what they owe, by when, and how to pay — using only the owner's real prices and terms, and writes the short message that goes with it.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- A job is finished (or a milestone is reached) and you need to bill.
- Turning an accepted quote into an invoice.
- Setting up a reusable invoice template in QuickBooks, Wave, Square, FreshBooks or a document.
- Billing a deposit or progress payment.

Do not use when:
- The invoice is already sent and unpaid → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence`.
- You need to decide deposit and payment terms first → `smallbiz-deposit-and-payment-terms`.
- Pricing a new job → `smallbiz-quote-builder` (task prepare-quotes).
- Seriously overdue accounts → `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan`.

## What to ask for first

1. Your business details: legal/trade name, address, phone, email, website; logo optional. EIN only if your customer needs it (usually on a W-9, not the invoice).
2. Customer details: name/company, billing address, contact person, PO number if they gave one.
3. What was delivered: items/services, quantities or hours, unit prices, dates of work. Link to the quote if one exists.
4. Sales tax: do you collect it, which state/local rate applies, and which items are taxable? (Many services are not taxed in some states, products often are — this varies [VERIFY with your state].)
5. Deposit or earlier payments received.
6. Payment terms already agreed (e.g., due on receipt, Net 15, Net 30) and any late fee in your written agreement.
7. Payment methods you accept (card link, ACH, check, Zelle/Venmo business, cash).

## Steps

1. **Header:** the word "Invoice", invoice number (sequential, never reused, e.g., 2025-041), invoice date, due date, your details, customer details, PO/quote reference.
2. **Line items:** short description a customer would recognize, date or period, quantity/hours, unit price, line total. Split materials and labor if your quote did.
3. **Totals:** subtotal → discounts → taxable subtotal → sales tax (rate and amount shown) → total → minus deposit/payments received → **balance due** (largest, boldest number).

# Invoice Builder

An invoice that is clear gets paid faster. This skill builds an invoice the customer can understand at a glance — what they bought, what they owe, by when, and how to pay — using only the owner's real prices and terms, and writes the short message that goes with it.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- A job is finished (or a milestone is reached) and you need to bill.
- Turning an accepted quote into an invoice.
- Setting up a reusable invoice template in QuickBooks, Wave, Square, FreshBooks or a document.
- Billing a deposit or progress payment.

Do not use when:
- The invoice is already sent and unpaid → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence`.
- You need to decide deposit and payment terms first → `smallbiz-deposit-and-payment-terms`.
- Pricing a new job → `smallbiz-quote-builder` (task prepare-quotes).
- Seriously overdue accounts → `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan`.

## What to ask for first

1. Your business details: legal/trade name, address, phone, email, website; logo optional. EIN only if your customer needs it (usually on a W-9, not the invoice).
2. Customer details: name/company, billing address, contact person, PO number if they gave one.
3. What was delivered: items/services, quantities or hours, unit prices, dates of work. Link to the quote if one exists.
4. Sales tax: do you collect it, which state/local rate applies, and which items are taxable? (Many services are not taxed in some states, products often are — this varies [VERIFY with your state].)
5. Deposit or earlier payments received.
6. Payment terms already agreed (e.g., due on receipt, Net 15, Net 30) and any late fee in your written agreement.
7. Payment methods you accept (card link, ACH, check, Zelle/Venmo business, cash).

## Steps

1. **Header:** the word "Invoice", invoice number (sequential, never reused, e.g., 2025-041), invoice date, due date, your details, customer details, PO/quote reference.

6. **Cover message:** 3–4 lines for email or text with amount, due date and pay link. Attach PDF; subject like "Invoice 2025-041 from Example Bakery — due Mar 15".

```
|---|---|---|---|---|

Total: $[ ]  Paid/deposit: −$[ ]  BALANCE DUE: $[ ]
```

skills.body:
# 청구서 작성

알아보기 쉬운 청구서가 빨리 입금됩니다. 이 스킬은 고객이 한눈에 무엇을 샀는지, 얼마를, 언제까지, 어떻게 내면 되는지 알 수 있는 청구서를 사장님의 실제 가격과 조건으로만 만들고, 세금계산서·현금영수증 발급 여부를 함께 정리합니다.

## 사용 시점 / 사용하지 않는 경우

사용하는 경우:
- 작업이 끝났거나 중간 단계가 끝나 대금을 청구할 때
- 승인된 견적서를 청구서로 바꿀 때
- 반복해서 쓸 청구서·거래명세서 양식을 만들 때
- 계약금·중도금을 청구할 때

사용하지 않는 경우:
- 이미 보냈는데 입금이 없음 → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-ko`
- 계약금·결제 조건부터 정해야 함 → `smallbiz-deposit-and-payment-terms-ko`
- 새 작업 가격 산정 → `smallbiz-quote-builder-ko`
- 오래 밀린 미수금 → `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan-ko`

## 먼저 확인할 사항

1. 공급자 정보: 상호, 대표자, 사업자등록번호, 주소, 연락처, 입금 계좌(사업용 계좌)
2. 사업자 유형: 일반과세자 / 간이과세자(세금계산서 발급 가능 여부가 매출 규모에 따라 다름 `[확인 필요]`) / 면세사업자(계산서)
3. 고객 정보: 개인인지 사업자인지, 사업자라면 상호·사업자등록번호·담당자·이메일(세금계산서 수신용)
4. 공급 내용: 품목·서비스, 수량·시간, 단가, 공급일. 견적서가 있으면 번호
5. 가격이 부가세 포함인지 별도인지
6. 받은 계약금·중도금
7. 합의한 결제 기한과 지연 조건(계약서·견적서에 적어 둔 것)

## 작성 절차

1. **머리말**: "청구서" 표기, 청구 번호(연속 번호, 예: 2025-041), 발행일, 결제 기한, 공급자·고객 정보, 견적서 번호
2. **품목**: 고객이 알아볼 수 있는 짧은 설명, 공급일, 수량, 단가, 금액. 견적서에서 재료비와 공임을 나눴다면 그대로 나눕니다.
3. **합계**: 공급가액 합계 → 할인 → 부가세(10%, 일반과세자가 과세 품목일 때) → 합계 금액 → 받은 계약금 차감 → **청구 금액**(가장 크게)
4. **세금 증빙 안내**
   - 사업자 고객: 세금계산서(면세는 계산서)를 발급합니다. 전자세금계산서는 홈택스나 발급 대행 서비스로 발급하며, 발급 기한(보통 공급한 달의 다음 달 10일)과 전자 발급 의무 대상 여부를 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
   - 개인 고객: 카드 결제는 카드 전표로, 계좌이체·현금은 현금영수증(소득공제용)을 발급합니다. 의무발행업종은 일정 금액 이상이면 요청이 없어도 발급해야 합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
   - 청구서 자체는 세금계산서를 대신하지 않습니다.
5. **결제 조건**: 기한을 날짜로("3월 15일까지"), 입금 계좌(예금주명 포함)·카드 결제 링크, 지연 조건은 **미리 합의한 경우에만** 적습니다.
6. **감사 인사와 문의처**
7. **함께 보낼 메시지**: 카카오톡·문자 3~4줄 또는 이메일. 금액, 기한, 입금 방법, PDF 첨부. 이메일 제목 예: "[예시베이커리] 청구서 2025-041 — 3월 15일까지"
8. **기록**: 미수금 목록에 추가해 독촉 일정을 시작합니다.

## 결과물 형식

```
청 구 서  No.[ ]                 발행일: [ ]   결제 기한: [ ]
공급자: [상호, 대표자, 사업자등록번호, 주소, 연락처]
공급받는 자: [상호/성명, 사업자등록번호(해당 시), 담당자]   견적서 번호: [ ]

| 품목 | 공급일 | 수량 | 단가 | 공급가액 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
공급가액 합계: [ ]원  할인: −[ ]원  부가세: [ ]원  합계: [ ]원
받은 계약금: −[ ]원   청구 금액: [ ]원

입금 계좌: [은행, 계좌번호, 예금주]   결제 기한: [ ]   지연 조건(합의 시): [ ]
세금 증빙: [세금계산서 / 계산서 / 현금영수증 / 카드 전표] — 발급 예정일: [ ]

함께 보낼 메시지: ...
확인할 빈칸: ...
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 청구 번호가 겹치지 않고 기한이 실제 날짜인가
- [ ] 단가가 견적서·가격표와 같고 계산이 맞는가
- [ ] 부가세 포함·별도가 분명하고 사업자 유형에 맞는가
- [ ] 계약금을 뺐는가
- [ ] 지연 조건은 미리 합의한 것만 적었는가
- [ ] 세금계산서·현금영수증 발급 계획이 있는가

## 한계

- 세무·법률 자문이 아닙니다. 세금계산서 발급 의무, 기한, 간이과세자 발급 가능 여부는 홈택스·세무사로 확인합니다 `[확인 필요]`.
- 가격, 세율, 고객 정보, 조건을 지어내지 않습니다.
- 홈택스에서 세금계산서를 대신 발급하지 않습니다.

## 결과물 형식

```

공급자: [상호, 대표자, 사업자등록번호, 주소, 연락처]
공급받는 자: [상호/성명, 사업자등록번호(해당 시), 담당자]   견적서 번호: [ ]

| 품목 | 공급일 | 수량 | 단가 | 공급가액 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
공급가액 합계: [ ]원  할인: −[ ]원  부가세: [ ]원  합계: [ ]원
받은 계약금: −[ ]원   청구 금액: [ ]원

입금 계좌: [은행, 계좌번호, 예금주]   결제 기한: [ ]   지연 조건(합의 시): [ ]
세금 증빙: [세금계산서 / 계산서 / 현금영수증 / 카드 전표] — 발급 예정일: [ ]
```

## 자체 점검

- [ ] 단가가 견적서·가격표와 같고 계산이 맞는가
- [ ] 부가세 포함·별도가 분명하고 사업자 유형에 맞는가
- [ ] 계약금을 뺐는가
- [ ] 지연 조건은 미리 합의한 것만 적었는가
- [ ] 세금계산서·현금영수증 발급 계획이 있는가

skills.body:
# Invoice Builder (GST invoice / bill बनाना)

साफ़ invoice जल्दी भुगतान दिलाता है। यह skill ऐसा invoice बनाता है जिसमें ग्राहक एक नज़र में देख सके कि क्या लिया, कितना देना है, कब तक और कैसे — सिर्फ़ मालिक के असली rates और terms से — और साथ भेजने वाला छोटा message भी।

## कब उपयोग करें / कब नहीं

उपयोग करें जब:
- काम पूरा हुआ या कोई milestone पूरा हुआ और bill भेजना है।
- मंज़ूर quotation को invoice में बदलना है।
- Tally, Vyapar, Zoho, Khatabook या Excel में बार-बार इस्तेमाल का format बनाना है।
- Advance/running bill बनाना है।

उपयोग न करें जब:
- Invoice भेज दिया, पैसा नहीं आया → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence-hi`
- पहले advance और payment terms तय करने हैं → `smallbiz-deposit-and-payment-terms-hi`
- नए काम का rate → `smallbiz-quote-builder-hi`
- बहुत पुरानी उधारी → `smallbiz-overdue-account-plan-hi`

## पहले क्या पूछें

1. आपकी details: नाम/trade name, address, phone, email, GSTIN (अगर है), Udyam number (MSME हैं तो — B2B ग्राहकों को बताना उपयोगी)।
2. GST स्थिति: regular, composition, या registered नहीं।
3. ग्राहक: नाम/फ़र्म, billing address, राज्य, GSTIN (B2B), PO number।
4. क्या दिया: items/services, मात्रा/unit, rate, HSN (goods) या SAC (services) code, GST दर — मालिक/CA से confirm `[जाँचें]`।
5. Rate GST सहित है या अलग?
6. पहले मिला advance।
7. तय payment terms (तुरंत, 7/15/30 दिन) और भुगतान के तरीक़े (UPI ID/QR, NEFT/RTGS bank details, cheque)।

## Steps

1. **Document का नाम सही रखें:**
   - Regular dealer → "Tax Invoice"।
   - Composition dealer → "Bill of Supply" और यह note कि composition taxable person GST collect नहीं कर सकता; GST अलग से न जोड़ें `[जाँचें]`।
   - Registration नहीं → सादा "Invoice/Bill", GST नहीं।
2. **Header:** आपकी details, GSTIN, invoice number (financial year में लगातार, unique, 16 अक्षरों तक `[जाँचें]`, जैसे EB/25-26/041), तारीख़, due date, ग्राहक details और GSTIN, place of supply (राज्य का नाम और code)।
3. **Line items:** विवरण, HSN/SAC (turnover के हिसाब से 4 या 6 अंक `[जाँचें]`), मात्रा, unit, rate, discount, taxable value।
4. **Tax:** ग्राहक उसी राज्य में → CGST + SGST (आधी-आधी दर); दूसरे राज्य में → IGST। हर दर और राशि दिखाएँ। Reverse charge लागू हो तो लिखें।
5. **Totals:** taxable value → GST → कुल → advance घटाएँ → **बाक़ी देय राशि** (सबसे बड़े अक्षरों में, शब्दों में भी)।
6. **Payment block:** due date, UPI ID/QR, bank (नाम, A/c, IFSC), cheque किसके नाम। MSME supplier हैं तो B2B invoice पर "Udyam Reg. No." और तय credit period लिखें (MSMED Act की 45 दिन की सीमा याद दिलाने में मदद करता है `[जाँचें]`)।
7. **E-invoice:** सालाना turnover तय सीमा से ऊपर हो (अभी ₹5 करोड़ बताई जाती है `[जाँचें]`) तो B2B invoice पर IRN/QR ज़रूरी — यह portal/software से बनता है।
8. **Signature** (authorised signatory) और धन्यवाद।
9. **WhatsApp/email message:** 3–4 lines — राशि, due date, UPI link, PDF।
10. **Record:** उधारी list में जोड़ें।

## Output format

```
TAX INVOICE / BILL OF SUPPLY / INVOICE      No.: [ ]   तारीख़: [ ]   Due: [ ]
Supplier: [नाम, address, GSTIN, phone]   Udyam: [ ]
Bill to: [नाम, address, राज्य, GSTIN]   Place of supply: [राज्य, code]

| # | विवरण | HSN/SAC | मात्रा | Unit | Rate | Discount | Taxable value |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
CGST [ ]%: ₹[ ]  SGST [ ]%: ₹[ ]  (या IGST [ ]%: ₹[ ])
कुल: ₹[ ]  Advance: −₹[ ]  देय राशि: ₹[ ] (शब्दों में: ...)

Payment: UPI [ID/QR] | Bank [ ] | Due [ ]   Reverse charge: हाँ/नहीं
Authorised signatory: ...

WhatsApp message: ...
Confirm करने वाले blanks: ...
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Document का नाम GST स्थिति से मेल खाता है।
- [ ] Invoice number unique और क्रम में।
- [ ] HSN/SAC और GST दर मालिक/CA से confirm (या `[जाँचें]`)।
- [ ] Intra-state = CGST+SGST, inter-state = IGST।
- [ ] Advance घटाया गया; गणित सही।
- [ ] Payment details इतनी पूरी कि ग्राहक बिना फ़ोन किए भुगतान कर सके।

## Limits

- Tax सलाह नहीं। GST दर, HSN/SAC, e-invoice और invoice नियम CA/GST portal से confirm करें `[जाँचें]`।
- Rate, GST दर, ग्राहक details या terms नहीं गढ़ता।
- GST portal पर IRN नहीं बनाता या filing नहीं करता।

skills.name: smallbiz-overdue-account-plan
skills.description: Builds a step-by-step plan for a seriously overdue customer account (usually 45+ days or repeated broken promises) — confirm the facts, call, offer a written payment plan, pause work, send a final demand letter, then choose between writing it off, a collection agency, small claims court or a contractor's lien — with drafts for each message and a decision table of cost vs. chance of recovery. Use for "customer won't pay", "final notice", "demand letter", "should I go to small claims", or "payment plan agreement".
skills.body:
# Overdue Account Plan

When polite reminders have not worked, the owner needs a calm plan, not angry emails. This skill lays out the options in order, estimates the effort and cost of each with the owner, and drafts the messages — keeping everything factual, documented and within the law.

## When to use / when not to use

Use when:
- An invoice is 45–60+ days overdue, or the customer has missed promised dates.
- The customer has gone silent.
- You are deciding whether to keep chasing, settle, write off or take formal action.

Do not use when:
- The invoice is only a little late → `smallbiz-payment-reminder-sequence`.
- The customer disputes quality or scope → fix that first (`smallbiz-complaint-recovery-reply`, `smallbiz-scope-change-quote`).
- You need an overview of all unpaid invoices → `smallbiz-receivables-aging-review`.
- The amount is large or the customer has a lawyer → talk to a lawyer now.

## What to ask for first

1. Invoice(s), amounts, due dates, what was delivered and proof (signed quote/contract, emails, photos, delivery receipts).
2. History: reminders sent, calls, promises, partial payments, any complaint raised.
3. Customer type: business or individual consumer; state they are in.
4. Your written terms: late fee, interest, collection costs clause, deposit.
5. Whether you can pause ongoing work or deliveries.
6. Your goal: keep the customer, get paid in full, or just close it out. Your time/money budget.

## Steps

1. **Check your own side.** Was the invoice received by the right person? Is there an unanswered complaint? Is any amount wrong? Fix errors first.
2. **Call** (script): calm, factual, ask what is going on, ask for a specific amount and date.
3. **Offer a payment plan** if they cannot pay at once: amounts, dates, what happens if a payment is missed. Put it in a short written agreement both sign or confirm by email.
4. **Pause new work** or deliveries until the account is current (if your terms allow), and tell them plainly.
5. **Final demand letter:** facts, amount, due date of original invoice, a final pay-by date (e.g., 10–14 days), payment instructions, and the next step you will actually take. Send by email and certified mail.
6. **Decide next step** using the decision table:
   - Settle for part (sometimes better than nothing — record it in writing).
   - Collection agency (they keep a share; ask the rate).
   - Small claims court (dollar limits and filing fees vary by state [VERIFY]; you may need to collect after winning).
   - Mechanic's/contractor's lien for construction and repair work (strict deadlines and notice rules by state [VERIFY with a lawyer]).
   - Write off (talk to your CPA about bad-debt treatment; for cash-basis businesses unpaid income was never counted [VERIFY]).
7. **Keep a log** of every contact: date, channel, what was said.
8. **Lesson:** what term or deposit would have prevented this → `smallbiz-deposit-and-payment-terms`.

## Output format

```
Account: [customer] — owed $[ ] — oldest due [date] — days overdue: [ ]
Evidence on file: [✓ list]   Open dispute? yes/no

Plan
| Step | Action | By date | Message draft | Done |
|---|---|---|---|---|

Decision table
| Option | Likely recovery | Cost / fees | Time | Relationship impact | Notes [VERIFY] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Drafts: call script / payment plan agreement / pause-work notice / final demand letter
Contact log template: Date | Channel | Who | Summary | Next step
```

## Quality checks

- [ ] Facts and amounts match the invoice and evidence.
- [ ] Every message is factual, private and free of insults or empty threats.
- [ ] Interest/late fees are only those agreed in writing.
- [ ] The demand letter states one clear deadline and one next step the owner has decided to take.
- [ ] State-specific limits and deadlines are marked [VERIFY].

## Limits

- Not legal advice. Debt-collection, lien and court rules vary by state; consult a lawyer for large amounts, liens, or if the customer disputes the debt.
- Never invents amounts, dates, legal deadlines or court limits.
- Never contact the customer's employer, family or social media about the debt, and never post about it publicly.
